literature.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期文献呈现多方向研究进展
literature.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒研究集中呈现以下进展。
key_findings_zh: 即使某些模型区室的实验数据不可用,DINN 也可以估计未知参数、捕获感染动态并预测疾病进展。该方法识别出黑猩猩之间差异显着的参数,并且 DINN 检测到的重要参数与全局敏感性分析中的参数一致。 [10.1016/j.mbs.2026.109780]
该指南优先考虑对 1992 年之前出生的成年人进行出生 队列研究 HBsAg 筛查,简化基于证据的 治疗 资格,纳入非侵入性纤维化评估和病毒学标准,一线使用高遗传屏障核苷(酸)类似物,HBV DNA 指导的 抗病毒药物 预防母婴 传播,结构化采用保守的 治疗 停药标准和基于风险的半年一次超声 监测 进行肝细胞癌长期护理。 [10.1007/s12072-026-11135-y]

确定了 8 名患者,其中大多数为男性(62.5%),非洲裔(87.5%),中位年龄为 38.5 岁。1 例(12.5%)发现拉米夫定耐药 突变(L180M、M204V),2 例(25%)发现替诺福韦耐药相关 突变(M267L/I),3 例(37.5%)发现免疫逃逸 突变,包括 T126I、D144E 和 G145R。治疗调整导致三例(37.5%)病例病毒得到抑制。 [10.1080/23744235.2026.2701171]
研究结果显示,研究参与者的平均年龄为33.94岁,中位年龄为31.5岁,女性和男性乙肝病毒阳性比例分别为51.5%和48.5%。结果表明,卡拉奇流行的可能优势基因型是D,其次是B和C,还观察到B、C和D的混合感染。 [10.1007/s42770-026-02044-1]
23.6% 的患者发生实验室综合恶化。ΔAPRI、ΔFIB-4 和 ΔGPR 是恶化的显着预测因子,其中 ΔFIB-4 显示出最强的关联性(每增加 1-SD,aOR 7.32)和最佳的区分度(AUC 0.730)。 [10.1016/j.ajg.2026.07.009]
literature.trend_or_risk_zh: 本期研究方向以入选文献实际覆盖的临床、流行病学、宿主生态、诊断或分子监测主题为准。

DINNs can estimate unknown parameters, capture infection dynamics, and predict disease progression even when experimental data for some model compartments are unavailable. [10.1016/j.mbs.2026.109780]

The guideline prioritizes birth-cohort HBsAg screening for adults born before 1992, simplified evidence-based treatment eligibility incorporating non-invasive fibrosis assessment and virological criteria, first-line use of high genetic-barrier nucleos(t)ide analogs, HBV DNA-guided antiviral prophylaxis for prevention of mother-to-child transmission, structured long-term care with conservative treatment discontinuation criteria and risk-based semiannual ultrasound surveillance for hepatocellular carcinoma. [10.1007/s12072-026-11135-y]
Eight patients were identified, mostly male (62.5%) and of African origin (87.5%), with a median age of 38.5 years. [10.1080/23744235.2026.2701171]

At 3 years 3% of patients in the control arm and 14% of patients in the PEG-IFNa arm lost HBsAg (odds ratio 5.39; 95% confidence interval, (1.11, 26.19); p=0.037). In the control arm 34.9% of patients returned to NA therapy compared to 28.4% in the PEG_IFNa- arm. [10.1097/hep.0000000000001821]

news.headline_zh: 乙型肝炎病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期乙型肝炎病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 威斯特摩兰卫生官员 Marcia Graham 博士在一次市政会议上敦促居民采取预防乙型肝炎的措施,包括 疫苗接种 和安全性行为。 [news-0836a1daabc51b04]
一项多中心、前瞻性、单臂、开放标签试验,评估索磷布韦/维帕他韦 (SOF/VEL) 与富马酸替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 预 治疗 在慢性 HBV/HCV 合并感染患者中的安全性和有效性。该研究得到证实并发表在《临床和转化肝病学杂志》上。 [news-4c8c38fbd17c1832]
一项基于人群的 队列研究 研究报告称,根据 13.7 年的随访,慢性乙型肝炎 患者的代谢功能障碍相关脂肪性肝病 (MASLD) 与心血管疾病和肝外癌症风险增加相关。 [news-3a24b56e80d1ff5d]
一名 29 岁孕妇 (Night Sheritan) 在常规产前筛查中确诊为 诊断 乙型肝炎。诊断 出人意料,因为她没有任何症状,这凸显了乙型肝炎的“无声感染”性质。 [news-5345e67d66c73f50]
专家报告称,根据 Korle Bu 教学医院 2021 年的一项研究以及其他医疗机构的类似研究结果,加纳 75% 的肝癌病例是由乙型肝炎引起的。这是肝病专家证实的说法。 [news-32009d0ffefde2fe]
news.trend_or_risk_zh: 风险判断仅依据入选来源已经确认的信息，不把媒体推测升级为官方结论。
news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Hepatitis B virus news developments.
key_findings_en: Medical Officer of Health for Westmoreland, Dr. Marcia Graham, urged residents to take precautionary measures against hepatitis B, including vaccination and safe sex practices, during a municipal meeting. [news-0836a1daabc51b04]

A multicenter, prospective, single-arm, open-label trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (SOF/VEL) with pre-treatment of tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic HBV/HCV coinfected patients. The study is confirmed and published in the Journal of Clinical and Translational Hepatology. [news-4c8c38fbd17c1832]

A population-based cohort study reported that metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD) in people with chronic hepatitis B is associated with increased risks of cardiovascular disease and extrahepatic cancers, based on 13.7 years of follow-up. [news-3a24b56e80d1ff5d]

Confirmed diagnosis of hepatitis B in a 29-year-old pregnant woman (Night Sheritan) during routine antenatal screening. The diagnosis was unexpected as she had no symptoms, highlighting the 'silent infection' nature of hepatitis B. [news-5345e67d66c73f50]

Experts reported that hepatitis B causes 75% of liver cancer cases in Ghana, based on a 2021 study at the Korle Bu Teaching Hospital and similar findings in other health facilities. This is a confirmed statement by liver disease specialists. [news-32009d0ffefde2fe]

papers.title: Prevalence of Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Cameroon: A Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub‐Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up‐to‐date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random‐effects meta‐analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher‐risk and relatively lower‐risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity ( I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta‐analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00–11.02) with high heterogeneity ( I 2 = 98.10% ) . The prevalences for relatively lower‐risk and higher‐risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84–10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28–15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

Key sources of heterogeneity included sex, geographical area, population risk groups, and study design. The findings emphasize the urgent need for targeted health interventions, particularly for males and high-prevalence regions, to address the persistent high burden of HBV in Cameroon.

papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT Chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection is a global public health problem, and many regions of Sub‐Saharan Africa are disproportionately affected, including Cameroon, where prevalence has previously been shown to be high. This study aimed to provide up‐to‐date estimates of HBV prevalence in Cameroon. We searched Medline, Global Health, Embase, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Africa Index Medicus and the Journal of Health Science and Disease at the University of Yaounde. We included studies reporting HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) prevalence in the general population and subpopulations. A random‐effects meta‐analysis was used to generate pooled estimates of HBsAg prevalence, overall and for population subgroups including those considered at relatively higher‐risk and relatively lower‐risk of HBV infection. Heterogeneity was assessed using the index of heterogeneity ( I 2 ). Quality was assessed using the Joanna Briggs Institute critical appraisal tool. Out of 1236 records, 92 papers with 100 studies were included in the meta‐analysis. Overall prevalence of HBV in Cameroon was 9.98% (95% confidence interval [CI] 9.00–11.02) with high heterogeneity ( I 2 = 98.10% ) . The prevalences for relatively lower‐risk and higher‐risk populations were8.94% (95% CI 7.84–10.11) and 12.70% (95% CI 10.28–15.32), respectively. In subgroup analyses, we found that sex, geographical area (regions), population risk groups and study design were the main sources of heterogeneity. Overall, HBV prevalence remains high in Cameroon. Our findings suggest an urgent need for health interventions to halt the spread of the disease, with particular attention needed for males and regions with the highest prevalence.

papers.title: National guideline for hepatitis B elimination in Thailand: a decentralized health system model for expanding diagnosis and treatment
papers.abstract: Despite sustained universal infant hepatitis B vaccination, chronic hepatitis B (CHB) remains an important cause of cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma in Thailand, particularly among adults born before vaccine implementation. This article summarizes the 2026 National Guideline on Elimination of Viral Hepatitis B in Thailand and presents a health-system framework for addressing the remaining disease burden. The guideline was developed by a multidisciplinary expert panel using evidence from international recommendations, peer-reviewed literature, national epidemiological data, implementation studies, and health economic analyses. The recommendations were formulated using the GRADE framework and adapted for implementation within Thailand's Universal Health Coverage system. The national strategy prioritizes birth-cohort HBsAg screening for adults born before 1992, simplified evidence-based treatment eligibility incorporating non-invasive fibrosis assessment and virological criteria, and first-line use of high genetic-barrier nucleos(t)ide analogs. Prevention of mother-to-child transmission prioritizes HBV DNA-guided antiviral prophylaxis, with simplified implementation pathways reserved for settings with substantial diagnostic constraints. Long-term care emphasizes structured monitoring, appropriate specialist referral, conservative treatment discontinuation criteria, defined retreatment thresholds, and risk-based semiannual ultrasound surveillance for hepatocellular carcinoma. Integration with antenatal services, HIV programs, and primary care facilities supports decentralized delivery and continuity of care. Thailand's 2026 hepatitis B guideline operationalizes evidence-based CHB management within a publicly financed decentralized health system and provides a scalable model for expanding hepatitis B diagnosis and treatment in endemic settings.

The national strategy prioritizes birth-cohort HBsAg screening for adults born before 1992, simplified evidence-based treatment eligibility incorporating non-invasive fibrosis assessment and virological criteria, and first-line use of high genetic-barrier nucleos(t)ide analogs. Long-term care emphasizes structured monitoring, appropriate specialist referral, conservative treatment discontinuation criteria, defined retreatment thresholds, and risk-based semiannual ultrasound surveillance for hepatocellular carcinoma. Integration with antenatal services, HIV programs, and primary care facilities supports decentralized delivery and continuity of care. Thailand's 2026 hepatitis B guideline operationalizes evidence-based CHB management within a publicly financed decentralized health system and provides a scalable model for expanding hepatitis B diagnosis and treatment in endemic settings.

analysis_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 该审查提出了 2026 年泰国消除病毒性乙型肝炎国家指南,该指南由多学科专家小组利用国际建议、同行评审文献、国家流行病学数据、实施研究和卫生经济分析中的证据制定,并使用 GRADE 框架制定并适应泰国全民健康覆盖体系的建议。

papers.title: Risk of Virological Failure After Switch to a Tenofovir-Sparing Dual Therapy in Virologically Suppressed People With HIV and Past HBV Infection.
papers.abstract: We compared the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens (TT) to TFV-sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed, HBsAg-/HBcAb+ people living with HIV (PLWH). We emulated a target trial including adults PLWH from five University Hospitals, with HBsAg-/HBcAb+ serostatus, starting a TT with unsuppressed serum HIV-RNA and reaching HIV-RNA 50 cp/mL or a single HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL) were estimated through a weighted Kaplan-Meier estimator. Overall, 415 PLWH were eligible for study analysis: 71 (17.1%) started a DT (3TC-based: 78.9%) during follow-up. They were mainly men (329, 79.3%), with a median age of 48 years. In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of VF were: 29.3% for DT and 29.9% for TT at 5 years (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: -28.7, +21.6). A higher VF risk was seen in the subset of PLWH with undetectable HBsAb at the longest follow-up available (4 years), independently of treatment group: 15.5% and 36.8% with DT and TT, respectively (difference: -21.3%; 95% CI: -30.3, -13.8). Switch to a TFV-sparing DT, compared with continuing a TT, was not associated with an increased risk of VF in PLWH and prior HBV infection.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to compare the effectiveness of tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens (TT) to TFV-sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed people living with HIV (PLWH) with past HBV infection, specifically those who were HBsAg-/HBcAb+.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was an emulation of a target trial including adults with HIV from five University Hospitals, who were HBsAg-/HBcAb+ and had virologically suppressed HIV-RNA, with 415 PLWH eligible for analysis, of whom 71 (17.1%) started a DT during follow-up.
analysis.methods: The study used a weighted Kaplan-Meier estimator to estimate the probabilities of virological failure (VF), defined as two consecutive HIV-RNA > 50 cp/mL or a single HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL, at 5 years.
analysis.main_results: In the weighted analysis, the estimated probabilities of VF were 29.3% for DT and 29.9% for TT at 5 years (difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: -28.7, +21.6). A higher VF risk was seen in the subset with undetectable HBsAb at the longest follow-up (4 years): 15.5% and 36.8% with DT and TT, respectively (difference: -21.3%; 95% CI: -30.3, -13.8).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that switching to a TFV-sparing DT, compared with continuing a TT, was not associated with an increased risk of VF in PLWH with prior HBV infection, providing new evidence for treatment options in this population.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings inform clinical practice by suggesting that TFV-sparing dual therapy may be a viable option for virologically suppressed PLWH with past HBV infection, potentially reducing long-term toxicity without increasing VF risk.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was an emulation of a target trial, which may introduce unmeasured confounding, but the large sample size and robust statistical analysis provide moderate confidence in the results.

analysis.summary_en: This study compared tenofovir (TFV)-based triple regimens (TT) to TFV-sparing dual therapies (DT) in virologically suppressed people living with HIV (PLWH) with past HBV infection (HBsAg-/HBcAb+). Among 415 eligible participants, 71 (17.1%) started a DT during follow-up. The weighted analysis showed no significant difference in virological failure (VF) risk at 5 years between DT (29.3%) and TT (29.9%; difference: 0.5%; 95% CI: -28.7, +21.6). However, a higher VF risk was observed in those with undetectable HBsAb at 4 years (DT: 15.5% vs. TT: 36.8%; difference: -21.3%; 95% CI: -30.3, -13.8). The authors concluded that switching to TFV-sparing DT is not associated with increased VF risk, offering a potentially safer alternative for this population.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在比较基于替诺福韦 (TFV) 的三联疗法 (TT) 与保留 TFV 的双重疗法 (DT) 对既往感染过 HBV 且病毒学受到抑制的 HIV 感染者 (PLWH) 的有效性,特别是那些 HBsAg-/HBcAb+ 的患者。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是对一项目标试验的模拟,包括来自五家大学医院的 HIV 感染者,他们的 HBsAg-/HBcAb+ 且 HIV-RNA 病毒学受到抑制,415 名 PLWH 符合分析条件,其中 71 名 (17.1%) 在随访期间开始接受 DT。
elements_zh.methods: 该研究使用加权 Kaplan-Meier 估计量来估计 5 年时病毒学失败 (VF) 的概率,其定义为连续两次 HIV-RNA > 50 cp/mL 或单个 HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL。
elements_zh.main_results: 在加权分析中,5 年时 DT 的 VF 估计概率为 29.3%,TT 为 29.9%(差异:0.5%;95% CI:-28.7,+21.6)。在最长随访时间(4 年)内未检出 HBsAb 的子集中,出现 VF 的风险较高:DT 和 TT 的风险分别为 15.5% 和 36.8%(差异:-21.3%;95% CI:-30.3,-13.8)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,与继续 TT 相比,转为保留 TFV 的 DT 与既往感染 HBV 的 PLWH 的 VF 风险增加无关,这为该人群中的 治疗 选择提供了新的证据。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为临床实践提供了信息,表明保留 TFV 的双重疗法可能是病毒学抑制的既往 HBV 感染的 PLWH 的可行选择,有可能减少长期毒性而不增加 VF 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是对目标试验的模拟,可能会引入无法测量的混杂因素,但大样本量和稳健的统计分析为结果提供了适度的可信度。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在比较基于替诺福韦 (TFV) 的三联疗法 (TT) 与保留 TFV 的双重疗法 (DT) 对既往感染过 HBV 且病毒学受到抑制的 HIV 感染者 (PLWH) 的有效性,特别是那些 HBsAg-/HBcAb+ 的患者。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是对一项目标试验的模拟,包括来自五家大学医院的 HIV 感染者,他们的 HBsAg-/HBcAb+ 且 HIV-RNA 病毒学受到抑制,415 名 PLWH 符合分析条件,其中 71 名 (17.1%) 在随访期间开始接受 DT。
analysis_zh.methods: 该研究使用加权 Kaplan-Meier 估计量来估计 5 年时病毒学失败 (VF) 的概率,其定义为连续两次 HIV-RNA > 50 cp/mL 或单个 HIV-RNA ≥ 200 cp/mL。
analysis_zh.main_results: 在加权分析中,5 年时 DT 的 VF 估计概率为 29.3%,TT 为 29.9%(差异:0.5%;95% CI:-28.7,+21.6)。在最长随访时间(4 年)内未检出 HBsAb 的子集中,出现 VF 的风险较高:DT 和 TT 的风险分别为 15.5% 和 36.8%(差异:-21.3%;95% CI:-30.3,-13.8)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,与继续 TT 相比,转为保留 TFV 的 DT 与既往感染 HBV 的 PLWH 的 VF 风险增加无关,这为该人群中的 治疗 选择提供了新的证据。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为临床实践提供了信息,表明保留 TFV 的双重疗法可能是病毒学抑制的既往 HBV 感染的 PLWH 的可行选择,有可能减少长期毒性而不增加 VF 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是对目标试验的模拟,可能会引入无法测量的混杂因素,但大样本量和稳健的统计分析为结果提供了适度的可信度。

papers.title: Clinical and virological characteristics of hepatitis B virus genotype E infection: a case series
papers.abstract: INTRODUCTION: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotype E, mainly found in sub-Saharan Africa, exhibits low genetic diversity, unique molecular markers and high recombination potential but remains under-studied. AIM: This study describes the clinical and virological characteristics, mutational profiles, antiviral treatment responses and phylogenetic data of patients with confirmed HBV genotype E infection in a tertiary-care centre in northern Italy. METHODS: A retrospective monocentric study was conducted at ASST Spedali Civili di Brescia, Italy, from 2015 to 2023. Patients with documented HBV genotype E who underwent genotypic resistance testing (GRT) for clinical reasons were included. Direct sequencing of the S/POL region was used for genotyping and mutation analysis, interpreted via Geno2pheno [hbv] 2.0 and Stanford HBV resistance tools. RESULTS: Eight patients were identified, mostly male (62.5%) and of African origin (87.5%), with a median age of 38.5 years. GRT was performed in six (75%) patients because of persistent viremia despite antiviral treatment, five (83.3%) of whom were HIV/HBV coinfected with detectable HIV viral load. Lamivudine resistance mutations (L180M, M204V) were found in one (12.5%) case, tenofovir resistance-associated mutations (M267L/I) in two (25%) and immune escape mutations in three (37.5%), including T126I, D144E and G145R. Despite GRT, treatment was not modified in four (50%) patients due to poor adherence concerns. Therapy adjustments led to viral suppression in three (37.5%) cases. CONCLUSION: In our setting, HBV genotype E infections largely occurred among migrants from endemic regions. Although nucleos(t)ide analogues are effective across genotypes, suboptimal adherence may hinder viral suppression and promote resistance.

papers.title: Validation of a Point‐Of‐Care Ultrasound for Hepatitis Among Front‐Line Healthcare Workers Managing Chronic Hepatitis B Virus Infection in Zambia
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT To close gaps in implementing care of people with hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection in resource‐limited settings, we evaluated the accuracy of a novel liver point‐of‐care ultrasound (POCUS) protocol for hepatitis (PUSH) among front‐line non‐radiology healthcare workers in Zambia. At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, we trained four nurses and six physicians with experience in HBV management, but not in ultrasound (US), in the PUSH protocol, which includes visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis‐suggestive features and liver lesions suspicious for hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). Then, consecutive adult participants with chronic hepatitis B (PWHB) alone or HBV/HIV coinfection underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data. We evaluated the accuracy of PUSH for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis using transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard test (RST) and for liver lesions that were possible HCC using a comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer as the RST. Nonparametric analysis of the receiver operating curve (ROC) for PUSH was adjusted for operator type (doctor vs. nurse), sex and HIV status. analysis.study_design_and_population: At University Teaching Hospital in Lusaka, Zambia, from March to June 2024, four nurses and six physicians with HBV management experience but no prior ultrasound training were trained in the PUSH protocol. Consecutive adults with chronic HBV, including those with HBV/HIV coinfection, underwent PUSH with operators blinded to clinical data.
analysis.methods: PUSH involved visualizing the liver in three windows (epigastric, subcostal, and right transcostal) to identify cirrhosis-suggestive features and HCC lesions. Accuracy for significant fibrosis and cirrhosis was assessed against transient elastography (TE) as the reference standard, while liver lesions were compared to comprehensive abdominal ultrasound by an experienced radiographer. Nonparametric ROC analysis adjusted for operator type, sex, and HIV status was used.
analysis.main_results: Among 197 participants, 17.7% had significant fibrosis, 11.6% had cirrhosis, and 3.5% had liver lesions by reference standards. PUSH showed low accuracy for significant fibrosis (sensitivity 8.3%, specificity 100.0%, AUROC 0.54), moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (sensitivity 60.9%, specificity 97.7%, AUROC 0.79), and high accuracy for liver lesions (sensitivity 85.7%, specificity 98.4%, AUROC 0.92).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors concluded that after expedited training, front-line nurses and physicians could use PUSH to diagnose cirrhosis with moderate accuracy and liver lesions with high accuracy, despite wide confidence intervals. They highlighted the potential utility of liver POCUS, including PUSH, in HBV management where laboratory systems and TE are unavailable.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest PUSH could support decentralized HBV care in low-resource settings by enabling front-line providers to screen for cirrhosis and HCC lesions, potentially improving early detection and linkage to treatment when advanced imaging is inaccessible.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study’s small sample size and wide confidence intervals limit precision, and the training duration was expedited, which may not reflect real-world retention of skills. The evidence is moderate due to these constraints and the single-centre design.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated a novel point-of-care ultrasound protocol (PUSH) for detecting significant fibrosis, cirrhosis, and hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) lesions in adults with chronic hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection managed by front-line healthcare workers in Zambia. After brief training, nurses and physicians used PUSH to assess liver disease with moderate accuracy for cirrhosis (sensitivity 60.9%, specificity 97.7%, AUROC 0.79) and high accuracy for HCC lesions (sensitivity 85.7%, specificity 98.4%, AUROC 0.92), though performance for significant fibrosis was low (AUROC 0.54). The authors propose PUSH as a practical tool for HBV care in settings lacking laboratory infrastructure or transient elastography. Limitations include a small sample size, wide confidence intervals, and a single-centre design, warranting larger, multi-centre validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于诊断能力的差距,慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在资源有限的环境中仍然管理不善,这促使需要可用的护理点工具。该研究旨在评估新型肝脏即时超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH) 是否能够准确识别由一线医护人员管理的慢性乙型肝炎成人患者中的显着纤维化、肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 病变。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡大学教学医院,四名护士和六名医生接受了 PUSH 方案的培训,这些护士具有 HBV 管理经验,但之前没有接受过超声培训。连续患有慢性 HBV 的成年人,包括 HBV/HIV 双重感染的患者,在不了解临床数据的操作员的情况下接受了 PUSH。
elements_zh.methods: PUSH 涉及在三个窗口(上腹、肋下和右经肋)观察肝脏,以识别肝硬化提示特征和 HCC 病变。以瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为参考标准评估显着纤维化和肝硬化的准确性,同时由经验丰富的放射技师将肝脏病变与综合腹部超声进行比较。使用根据操作员类型、性别和 HIV 状况进行调整的非参数 ROC 分析。
elements_zh.main_results: 根据参考标准,197 名参与者中,17.7% 患有明显纤维化,11.6% 患有肝硬化,3.5% 患有肝脏病变。PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,经过快速培训后,一线护士和医生可以使用 PUSH 以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,尽管置信区间较宽。他们强调了肝脏 POCUS(包括 PUSH)在实验室系统和 TE 不可用的 HBV 管理中的潜在效用。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,PUSH 可以通过使一线提供者能够筛查肝硬化和 HCC 病变来支持资源匮乏环境中的分散式 HBV 护理,从而有可能改善早期检测以及在无法获得高级成像时与 治疗 的联系。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量小和置信区间宽限制了精度,并且训练时间加快,这可能无法反映现实世界中技能的保留情况。由于这些限制和单中心设计,证据是中等的。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 由于诊断能力的差距,慢性乙型肝炎 病毒 (HBV) 感染在资源有限的环境中仍然管理不善,这促使需要可用的护理点工具。该研究旨在评估新型肝脏即时超声 (POCUS) 方案 (PUSH) 是否能够准确识别由一线医护人员管理的慢性乙型肝炎成人患者中的显着纤维化、肝硬化和肝细胞癌 (HCC) 病变。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 3 月至 6 月,在赞比亚卢萨卡大学教学医院,四名护士和六名医生接受了 PUSH 方案的培训,这些护士具有 HBV 管理经验,但之前没有接受过超声培训。连续患有慢性 HBV 的成年人,包括 HBV/HIV 双重感染的患者,在不了解临床数据的操作员的情况下接受了 PUSH。
analysis_zh.methods: PUSH 涉及在三个窗口(上腹、肋下和右经肋)观察肝脏,以识别肝硬化提示特征和 HCC 病变。以瞬时弹性成像 (TE) 作为参考标准评估显着纤维化和肝硬化的准确性,同时由经验丰富的放射技师将肝脏病变与综合腹部超声进行比较。使用根据操作员类型、性别和 HIV 状况进行调整的非参数 ROC 分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 根据参考标准,197 名参与者中,17.7% 患有明显纤维化,11.6% 患有肝硬化,3.5% 患有肝脏病变。PUSH 对显着纤维化的准确性较低(敏感性 8.3%,特异性 100.0%,AUROC 0.54),对肝硬化的准确性中等(敏感性 60.9%,特异性 97.7%,AUROC 0.79),对肝脏病变的准确性较高(敏感性 85.7%,特异性 98.4%,AUROC 0.92)。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者得出的结论是,经过快速培训后,一线护士和医生可以使用 PUSH 以中等准确度诊断肝硬化,并以较高准确度诊断肝脏病变,尽管置信区间较宽。他们强调了肝脏 POCUS(包括 PUSH)在实验室系统和 TE 不可用的 HBV 管理中的潜在效用。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,PUSH 可以通过使一线提供者能够筛查肝硬化和 HCC 病变来支持资源匮乏环境中的分散式 HBV 护理,从而有可能改善早期检测以及在无法获得高级成像时与 治疗 的联系。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的样本量小和置信区间宽限制了精度,并且训练时间加快,这可能无法反映现实世界中技能的保留情况。由于这些限制和单中心设计,证据是中等的。

papers.title: Distribution of hepatitis B virus genotypes and demography in the general population of Karachi, Sindh
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B is a major global burden, with 253 million infected people. There are at least ten Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotypes and 35 subgenotypes, with distinct ethno-geographical distributions and manifest differences in their biological characteristics, display close association with clinical outcomes, severity of disease, and response to antiviral therapy. The aim of the study was to identify the predominant circulating genotypes of HBV in the population of Karachi, Sindh. A demographic assessment was conducted alongside a serological evaluation of markers specifically HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb to determine the clinical infection profile of the study cohort. An initial molecular identification was performed by first round of PCR via specific primers P1 and S1-2 for PreS1/S2 gene. The HBV genotypes (A to F) was determined by nested PCR using primer pairs for the conserved sequence of HBV pre-S gene and S gene, and subsequently validated by phylogenetic analysis. The study findings indicated that the mean age of the study participants was 33.94 years, with a median age of 31.5 years. The percentage of HBV positive female and male were 51.5% and 48.5%, respectively. The results of this pilot study indicated that the probable predominant genotype circulating in Karachi is D, followed by B and C. Mixed infection of B, C, and D was also observed. Almost all the D positive samples were positive for HBsAg.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Hepatitis B is a major global burden, with 253 million infected people, and there are at least ten HBV genotypes and 35 subgenotypes with distinct ethno-geographical distributions and clinical outcomes. The study aimed to identify the predominant circulating genotypes of HBV in the population of Karachi, Sindh.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A demographic assessment was conducted alongside a serological evaluation of markers specifically HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb to determine the clinical infection profile of the study cohort.
analysis.methods: An initial molecular identification was performed by first round of PCR via specific primers P1 and S1-2 for PreS1/S2 gene, and HBV genotypes (A to F) were determined by nested PCR using primer pairs for the conserved sequence of HBV pre-S gene and S gene, subsequently validated by phylogenetic analysis.
analysis.main_results: The study findings indicated that the mean age of the study participants was 33.94 years, with a median age of 31.5 years, and the percentage of HBV positive female and male were 51.5% and 48.5%, respectively. The results indicated that the probable predominant genotype circulating in Karachi is D, followed by B and C, with mixed infection of B, C, and D also observed.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the identification of genotype D as predominant in Karachi provides insights into the local HBV epidemiology and its association with clinical outcomes, as almost all D positive samples were positive for HBsAg.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform targeted surveillance and vaccination strategies in Karachi, considering the predominant genotype D and its clinical implications, and may guide future studies on genotype-specific treatment approaches.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study was a pilot with a limited sample size, which may affect the generalizability of the findings, but the use of molecular and phylogenetic methods provides moderate confidence in the genotype distribution results.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigated the distribution of hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotypes in the general population of Karachi, Sindh. A demographic and serological assessment was conducted, followed by molecular identification using PCR and phylogenetic analysis. papers.source_body_en: Hepatitis B is a major global burden, with 253 million infected people. There are at least ten Hepatitis B virus (HBV) genotypes and 35 subgenotypes, with distinct ethno-geographical distributions and manifest differences in their biological characteristics, display close association with clinical outcomes, severity of disease, and response to antiviral therapy. The aim of the study was to identify the predominant circulating genotypes of HBV in the population of Karachi, Sindh. A demographic assessment was conducted alongside a serological evaluation of markers specifically HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb to determine the clinical infection profile of the study cohort. An initial molecular identification was performed by first round of PCR via specific primers P1 and S1-2 for PreS1/S2 gene. The HBV genotypes (A to F) was determined by nested PCR using primer pairs for the conserved sequence of HBV pre-S gene and S gene, and subsequently validated by phylogenetic analysis. The study findings indicated that the mean age of the study participants was 33.94 years, with a median age of 31.5 years. The percentage of HBV positive female and male were 51.5% and 48.5%, respectively. The results of this pilot study indicated that the probable predominant genotype circulating in Karachi is D, followed by B and C. Mixed infection of B, C, and D was also observed. Almost all the D positive samples were positive for HBsAg.

papers.title: Exploration of Hepatitis B Virus Infection Dynamics through Physics-Informed Deep Learning Approach
papers.abstract: Accurate forecasting of viral disease outbreaks is crucial for guiding public health responses and preventing widespread loss of life. Recently, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising framework for capturing viral infection dynamics and predicting their future progression. Standard PINNs are effective in simulating disease dynamics through forward modeling approach; however, they often face challenges in estimating key biological parameters from sparse or noisy data in inverse problems. To overcome these limitations, a recent extension, known as Disease-Informed Neural Networks (DINNs), has gained attention as a robust framework for parameter estimation. In this work, we apply this DINN technique to a recently proposed hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection dynamics model to predict the transmission of infection within the liver. The model consists of four compartments: uninfected and infected hepatocytes, relaxed circular DNA (rcDNA)-containing capsids, and free viruses. Before estimating the parameters, a structural identifiability analysis is performed to determine the identifiable parameters of this model. Then, we study the impacts of (i) variations in parameter ranges, (ii) experimental noise, (iii) sample size, (iv) network architecture, and (v) learning rate on the performance of DINNs. Furthermore, using experimental data from nine HBV-infected chimpanzees, we observe that DINNs can estimate unknown parameters, capture infection dynamics, and predict disease progression even when experimental data for some model compartments are not available. Additionally, DINNs identify the model parameters that vary significantly across chimpanzees. A global sensitivity analysis is further performed, and the results indicate that significant parameters are consistent with those detected by DINNs. Finally, comparison with nonlinear least-squares fitting and maximum likelihood estimation demonstrates the advantages of DINNs in parameter estimation.

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: Accurate forecasting of viral disease outbreaks is crucial for guiding public health responses and preventing widespread loss of life. Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising framework for capturing viral infection dynamics and predicting their future progression.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: This study applies Disease-Informed Neural Networks (DINNs) to a hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection dynamics model to predict transmission within the liver. The model consists of four compartments: uninfected and infected hepatocytes, relaxed circular DNA (rcDNA)-containing capsids, and free viruses. The analysis uses experimental data from nine HBV-infected chimpanzees.
analysis_en.methods: Before estimating parameters, a structural identifiability analysis is performed to determine identifiable parameters. The study examines the impacts of parameter variations, experimental noise, sample size, network architecture, and learning rate on DINN performance. A global sensitivity analysis is conducted, and results are compared with nonlinear least-squares fitting and maximum likelihood estimation.
analysis_en.main_results: DINNs can estimate unknown parameters, capture infection dynamics, and predict disease progression even when experimental data for some model compartments are unavailable. The method identifies parameters that vary significantly across chimpanzees, and significant parameters detected by DINNs are consistent with those from global sensitivity analysis.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpret DINNs as a robust framework for parameter estimation in viral infection dynamics, overcoming limitations of standard PINNs in inverse problems. The novelty lies in applying DINNs to HBV infection dynamics and demonstrating their effectiveness with sparse or noisy data.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform HBV surveillance and treatment strategies by improving parameter estimation and prediction of disease progression. The approach may be applicable to other viral infections with compartmental models, enhancing public health preparedness.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study's evidence strength is moderate, as it demonstrates DINN effectiveness in a controlled setting with chimpanzee data but lacks validation in human populations. Limitations include potential generalizability issues and reliance on a specific HBV model structure.

papers.title_zh: 通过物理信息深度学习方法探索 乙型肝炎病毒 感染动力学
papers.source_body_en: Accurate forecasting of viral disease outbreaks is crucial for guiding public health responses and preventing widespread loss of life. Recently, Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) have emerged as a promising framework for capturing viral infection dynamics and predicting their future progression. Standard PINNs are effective in simulating disease dynamics through forward modeling approach; however, they often face challenges in estimating key biological parameters from sparse or noisy data in inverse problems. To overcome these limitations, a recent extension, known as Disease-Informed Neural Networks (DINNs), has gained attention as a robust framework for parameter estimation. In this work, we apply this DINN technique to a recently proposed hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection dynamics model to predict the transmission of infection within the liver. The model consists of four compartments: uninfected and infected hepatocytes, relaxed circular DNA (rcDNA)-containing capsids, and free viruses. Before estimating the parameters, a structural identifiability analysis is performed to determine the identifiable parameters of this model. Then, we study the impacts of (i) variations in parameter ranges, (ii) experimental noise, (iii) sample size, (iv) network architecture, and (v) learning rate on the performance of DINNs. Furthermore, using experimental data from nine HBV-infected chimpanzees, we observe that DINNs can estimate unknown parameters, capture infection dynamics, and predict disease progression even when experimental data for some model compartments are not available. Additionally, DINNs identify the model parameters that vary significantly across chimpanzees. A global sensitivity analysis is further performed, and the results indicate that significant parameters are consistent with those detected by DINNs. Finally, comparison with nonlinear least-squares fitting and maximum likelihood estimation demonstrates the advantages of DINNs in parameter estimation.

papers.title: Dynamic changes in non-invasive fibrosis scores as early predictors of deterioration in chronic hepatitis B
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND STUDY AIMS: Non-invasive scores such as APRI, FIB-4, GPR and ALBI are commonly used to evaluate liver fibrosis and functional reserve in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, interpretation has predominantly focused on single-time measurements, and the prognostic value of short-term changes (delta scores) remains uncertain. This study evaluated whether one-year changes in these scores are associated with laboratory-based composite deterioration during routine follow-up of CHB patients. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort included adult CHB patients with two laboratory assessments approximately 12 months apart. APRI, FIB-4, GPR and ALBI were calculated at baseline (T0) and follow-up (T1); delta values were defined as ΔScore = T1 - T0. Laboratory-based composite deterioration was defined as meeting ≥1 criterion based on albumin, total bilirubin, INR, or platelet count. Logistic regression models, adjusted for age, gender, HBV-DNA level, HBeAg status, and antiviral therapy assessed associations between delta scores and deterioration. ROC analysis evaluated discriminative performance. RESULTS: A total of 297 patients were included (56.9% male; median age 45 years). Laboratory-based composite deterioration occurred in 23.6%. Baseline non-invasive scores were not associated with deterioration, while ΔAPRI, ΔFIB-4 and ΔGPR were significant predictors. In multivariable analyses, each 0.1-unit increase corresponded to higher risk: ΔAPRI (aOR 1.55; p = 0.004), ΔFIB-4 (aOR 1.29; p < 0.001) and ΔGPR (aOR 1.86; p = 0.001). When standardized, ΔFIB-4 demonstrated the strongest association (aOR 7.32 per 1-SD increase). ΔFIB-4 also showed the best discrimination (AUC 0.730). CONCLUSION: One-year dynamic changes in non-invasive scores, particularly ΔFIB-4, provide additional and clinically relevant prognostic information for identifying early deterioration during routine follow-up. Incorporating delta score monitoring into clinical practice may help to detect laboratory-based deterioration at an earlier stage.

papers.title_zh: 非侵入性纤维化评分的动态变化作为 慢性乙型肝炎 恶化的早期预测因子
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND STUDY AIMS: Non-invasive scores such as APRI, FIB-4, GPR and ALBI are commonly used to evaluate liver fibrosis and functional reserve in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB). However, interpretation has predominantly focused on single-time measurements, and the prognostic value of short-term changes (delta scores) remains uncertain. This study evaluated whether one-year changes in these scores are associated with laboratory-based composite deterioration during routine follow-up of CHB patients. PATIENTS AND METHODS: This retrospective cohort included adult CHB patients with two laboratory assessments approximately 12 months apart. APRI, FIB-4, GPR and ALBI were calculated at baseline (T0) and follow-up (T1); delta values were defined as ΔScore = T1 - T0. Laboratory-based composite deterioration was defined as meeting ≥1 criterion based on albumin, total bilirubin, INR, or platelet count. Logistic regression models, adjusted for age, gender, HBV-DNA level, HBeAg status, and antiviral therapy assessed associations between delta scores and deterioration. ROC analysis evaluated discriminative performance. RESULTS: A total of 297 patients were included (56.9% male; median age 45 years). Laboratory-based composite deterioration occurred in 23.6%. Baseline non-invasive scores were not associated with deterioration, while ΔAPRI, ΔFIB-4 and ΔGPR were significant predictors. In multivariable analyses, each 0.1-unit increase corresponded to higher risk: ΔAPRI (aOR 1.55; p = 0.004), ΔFIB-4 (aOR 1.29; p < 0.001) and ΔGPR (aOR 1.86; p = 0.001). When standardized, ΔFIB-4 demonstrated the strongest association (aOR 7.32 per 1-SD increase). ΔFIB-4 also showed the best discrimination (AUC 0.730). CONCLUSION: One-year dynamic changes in non-invasive scores, particularly ΔFIB-4, provide additional and clinically relevant prognostic information for identifying early deterioration during routine follow-up. Incorporating delta score monitoring into clinical practice may help to detect laboratory-based deterioration at an earlier stage.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景和研究目的:APRI、FIB-4、GPR 和 ALBI 等无创评分通常用于评估 慢性乙型肝炎 (CHB) 患者的肝纤维化和功能储备。然而,解释主要集中在单次测量上,短期变化(增量分数)的预后价值仍然不确定。本研究评估了这些评分的一年变化是否与慢性乙型肝炎患者常规随访期间基于实验室的综合恶化有关。患者和方法:这项回顾性 队列研究 包括成年 CHB 患者,两次实验室评估相隔约 12 个月。在基线(T0)和随访(T1)时计算APRI、FIB-4、GPR和ALBI;增量值定义为 ΔScore = T1 - T0。基于实验室的复合恶化被定义为基于白蛋白、总胆红素、INR或血小板计数满足≥1个标准。根据年龄、性别、HBV-DNA 水平、HBeAg 状态和 抗病毒药物 治疗进行调整的逻辑回归模型评估了 delta 评分与恶化之间的关联。ROC 分析评估了判别性能。结果:总共纳入 297 名患者(56.9% 为男性;中位年龄 45 岁)。实验室复合材料劣化发生率为 23.6%。基线无创评分与病情恶化无关,而 ΔAPRI、ΔFIB-4 和 ΔGPR 是显着的预测因子。在多变量分析中,每增加 0.1 个单位对应更高的风险:ΔAPRI (aOR 1.55;p = 0.004)、ΔFIB-4 (aOR 1.29;p < 0.001) 和 ΔGPR (aOR 1.86;p = 0.001)。标准化后,ΔFIB-4 表现出最强的关联(每增加 1-SD,aOR 7.32)。ΔFIB-4 也表现出最好的辨别力(AUC 0.730)。结论:非侵入性评分(尤其是 ΔFIB-4)的一年动态变化为在常规随访期间识别早期恶化提供了额外的临床相关预后信息。将 delta 评分监测纳入临床实践可能有助于在早期阶段检测基于实验室的恶化。

papers.title: Nucleos(t)ide withdrawal vs Nucleos(t)ide withdrawal with adjuvant pegylated-interferon in HBeAg-negative hepatitis B virus infection (NUC-B Trial).
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Finite therapy resulting in sustained hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss for patients with chronic HBV infection (CHB) is an important therapeutic goal. In patients with HBeAg-negative infection, nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) withdrawal may achieve HBsAg loss in 5-20% of patients after 3 years. Pegylated interferon (PEG-IFNa) is a recognised treatment for CHB. METHODS: NUC-B was a randomised, multi-centre trial in NA-treated non-cirrhotic HBeAg negative patients with CHB. Patients were allocated to either NA withdrawal alone (control) or NA withdrawal followed by a 16 week course of PEG-IFNa 180ug weekly commencing 4 weeks after NA cessation (PEG-IFNa). The primary endpoint was HBsAg loss at 3 years. RESULTS: The target recruitment of 240 patients was not achieved. 156 patients, 82 to control arm , 74 to PEG-IFNa arm , were recruited between 2017 and 2021; median age 45 years, 24% female, HBV Genotypes -A 16%, B 6%, C 4%, D 24%, E 22%, other 1%, unknown 26%. At 3 years 3% of patients in the contol arm and 14% of patients in the PEG-IFNa arm lost HBsAg (odds ratio 5.39; 95% confidence interval, (1.11, 26.19); p=0.037). In the control arm 34.9% of patients returned to NA therapy compared to 28.4% in the PEG_IFNa- arm. Exaggerated flares occurred in 27.9% of patients in the control arm compared with 13.4% in the PEG-IFNa arm. CONCLUSIONS: The use of adjuvant PEG-IFNa therapy after withdrawal of NA therapy increases the rate of HBsAg loss whilst simultaneously reducing the number of exaggerated flares.

analysis.research_question_and_background: Finite therapy resulting in sustained hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) loss for patients with chronic HBV infection (CHB) is an important therapeutic goal. In patients with HBeAg-negative infection, nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) withdrawal may achieve HBsAg loss in 5-20% of patients after 3 years.
analysis.study_design_and_population: NUC-B was a randomised, multi-centre trial in NA-treated non-cirrhotic HBeAg negative patients with CHB. 156 patients, 82 to control arm and 74 to PEG-IFNa arm, were recruited between 2017 and 2021; median age 45 years, 24% female, HBV Genotypes -A 16%, B 6%, C 4%, D 24%, E 22%, other 1%, unknown 26%.
analysis.methods: Patients were allocated to either NA withdrawal alone (control) or NA withdrawal followed by a 16 week course of PEG-IFNa 180ug weekly commencing 4 weeks after NA cessation (PEG-IFNa). The primary endpoint was HBsAg loss at 3 years.
analysis.main_results: At 3 years 3% of patients in the control arm and 14% of patients in the PEG-IFNa arm lost HBsAg (odds ratio 5.39; 95% confidence interval, (1.11, 26.19); p=0.037). In the control arm 34.9% of patients returned to NA therapy compared to 28.4% in the PEG_IFNa- arm. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The use of adjuvant PEG-IFNa therapy after withdrawal of NA therapy increases the rate of HBsAg loss whilst simultaneously reducing the number of exaggerated flares.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that adding PEG-IFNa to NA withdrawal may improve treatment outcomes for HBeAg-negative CHB patients by increasing HBsAg loss and reducing liver flares.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The target recruitment of 240 patients was not achieved, limiting the statistical power. The evidence strength is moderate due to the underpowered trial but the significant odds ratio and consistent secondary outcomes support the conclusion.

analysis.summary_en: The NUC-B trial investigated whether adding pegylated interferon (PEG-IFNa) to nucleos(t)ide analogue (NA) withdrawal improves outcomes in HBeAg-negative chronic hepatitis B patients. In this randomized multi-center study, 156 patients were assigned to NA withdrawal alone or NA withdrawal followed by 16 weeks of PEG-IFNa. At 3 years, 14% of the PEG-IFNa group achieved HBsAg loss compared to 3% in the control group (OR 5.39; 95% CI 1.11-26.19; p=0.037). The PEG-IFNa group also had fewer exaggerated flares (13.4% vs 27.9%) and similar rates of returning to NA therapy. The study suggests that adjuvant PEG-IFNa after NA withdrawal significantly increases HBsAg loss while reducing liver flares, though the trial was underpowered with only 156 of 240 planned patients recruited.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 对于慢性 HBV 感染 (CHB) 患者来说,有限治疗导致乙型肝炎表面抗原 (HBsAg) 持续丧失是一个重要的治疗目标。在 HBeAg 阴性感染患者中,停用核苷(酸)类似物 (NA) 可能会在 3 年后使 5-20% 的患者实现 HBsAg 消失。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: NUC-B是一项随机、多中心试验,研究对象为接受NA治疗的非肝硬化HBeAg阴性CHB患者。2017年至2021年间共入组156例患者,其中82例分配至对照组,74例分配至PEG-IFNa组;中位年龄45岁,女性占24%,HBV基因型分布为:A型16%、B型6%、C型4%、D型24%、E型22%、其他1%、未知26%。
elements_zh.methods: 患者被分配为仅 NA 停药组(对照)或 NA 停药组,然后在 NA 停止 (PEG-IFNa) 4 周后开始每周 16 周的 PEG-IFNa 180ug 疗程。主要终点是 3 年时 HBsAg 消失。
elements_zh.main_results: At 3 years 3% of patients in the control arm and 14% of patients in the PEG-IFNa arm lost HBsAg (odds ratio 5.39; 95% confidence interval, (1.11, 26.19); p=0.037). Exaggerated flares occurred in 27.9% of patients in the control arm compared with 13.4% in the PEG-IFNa arm.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 取消 NA 治疗后使用辅助 PEG-IFNa 治疗会增加 HBsAg 消失率,同时减少过度发作的次数。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,在 NA 停药中添加 PEG-IFNa 可能会通过增加 HBsAg 丢失和减少肝脏耀斑来改善 HBeAg 阴性 CHB 患者的 治疗 结局。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 招募 240 名患者的目标并未实现,限制了统计能力。由于试验力度不足,证据强度中等,但显着的比值比和一致的次要结果支持了这一结论。

papers.title: Differential Hepatitis B Surface Antigen Glycan Isomer Kinetics Between Tenofovir Alafenamide and Entecavir: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Stratification in Hepatitis B e Antigen-Positive Patients.
papers.abstract: Nucleos(t)ide analog (NA) therapy suppresses hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA, but residual hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) risk persists. O-glycosylated hepatitis B surface antigen glycan isomer (HBsAgGi) uniquely reflects virion burden. We evaluated the impact of tenofovir alafenamide (TAF) versus entecavir (ETV) on 48-week HBsAgGi kinetics and its utility in stratifying HCC risk in 90 NA-naïve patients (ETV: 73; TAF: 17). A favourable response was defined as a reduction or maintenance of low HBsAgGi levels. TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). A significant interaction occurred between HBeAg status and HBsAgGi response in relation to HCC development (p = 0.038). In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs. This association was absent in HBeAg-negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long-term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg-positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C-specific O-glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. In conclusion, on-treatment HBsAgGi response is a specific surrogate marker for stratifying residual HCC risk in HBeAg-positive patients, and TAF is more effective than ETV in inducing these favourable kinetics.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 核苷类似物 (NA) 疗法可抑制 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) DNA,但残留肝细胞癌 (HCC) 风险仍然存在。O-糖基化乙型肝炎表面抗原聚糖异构体 (HBsAgGi) 独特地反映了病毒颗粒负荷。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们评估了替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 与恩替卡韦 (ETV) 对 48 周 HBsAgGi 动力学的影响及其在 90 名未接受 NA 治疗的患者中对 HCC 风险进行分层的效用(ETV:73;TAF:17)。
elements_zh.methods: 由于该测定以基因型 C 特异性 O-糖基化为目标,因此研究结果不能推广到基因型 A、B 或 D。有利的反应被定义为降低或维持低 HBsAgGi 水平。
elements_zh.main_results: TAF independently predicted a favourable response compared with ETV (penalised odds ratio 3.60, p = 0.030). In HBeAg-positive patients, a poor response was associated with increased HCC risk (hazard ratio 7.34, 95% confidence interval [CI] 1.96-20.35, p = 0.001); however, the exact magnitude warrants cautious interpretation due to wide CIs.
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总之,on-治疗 HBsAgGi 反应是 HBeAg 阳性患者残留 HCC 风险分层的特异性替代标志物,TAF 在诱导这些有利动力学方面比 ETV 更有效。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 将 HBsAgGi 反应添加到 aMAP 评分中,仅改善了 HBeAg 阳性 队列研究 中的长期 HCC 预测。HBeAg 状态和 HBsAgGi 反应之间存在与 HCC 发展相关的显着交互作用 (p = 0.038)。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据未报告基因型 C 之外的具体设计限制、偏倚、混杂因素或普遍性。由于样本量有限且置信区间较宽,证据强度中等。

This association was absent in HBeAg-negative cases. Adding HBsAgGi response to the aMAP score improved long-term HCC prediction exclusively in the HBeAg-positive cohort. As the assay targets genotype C-specific O-glycosylation, the findings cannot be generalised to genotypes A, B, or D. analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们评估了替诺福韦艾拉酚胺 (TAF) 与恩替卡韦 (ETV) 对 48 周 HBsAgGi 动力学的影响及其在 90 名未接受 NA 治疗的患者中对 HCC 风险进行分层的效用(ETV:73;TAF:17)。
analysis_zh.methods: 由于该测定以基因型 C 特异性 O-糖基化为目标,因此研究结果不能推广到基因型 A、B 或 D。有利的反应被定义为降低或维持低 HBsAgGi 水平。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总之,on-治疗 HBsAgGi 反应是 HBeAg 阳性患者残留 HCC 风险分层的特异性替代标志物,TAF 在诱导这些有利动力学方面比 ETV 更有效。

papers.title: Trends in Hepatitis B, Hepatitis C, and HIV Seroprevalence in the Netherlands: Insights From Two Decades of Nationwide PIENTER Serosurveys.
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B (HBV), hepatitis C (HCV), and HIV remain public health challenges despite effective treatments and preventive options. Infections are often asymptomatic, leading to undiagnosed cases, onward transmission, and preventable morbidity and mortality. In the Netherlands, disease burden is concentrated in specific populations, with many undetected infections. We estimated HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence, identified determinants, and assessed trends over 20 years using data from 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years from three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER: 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017). Participants completed questionnaires on demographics, behaviour, and socio-economic factors, and serum samples were tested for HBV and HCV in all rounds and HIV in 2017. Seroprevalence estimates were weighted to the Dutch population, trends were analysed using weighted Poisson regression, and determinants were evaluated using multivariable Poisson regression. Weighted HBV seroprevalence remained stable across surveys (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection). HBV prevalence was highest among first-generation migrants, with older age, migration background, and STI history as key determinants. HCV seroprevalence remained low (< 0.4%) and was highest among non-Western migrants. HIV prevalence was 0.1% and highest among non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men. Only 9% of active HBV cases were aware of their status. Overall, HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence remain low in the Netherlands but are concentrated in specific groups with limited awareness. These findings support targeted prevention, screening, and linkage-to-care strategies to achieve the 2030 WHO elimination goals and highlight the importance of continued population-based (sero-)monitoring to guide public health policy.

analysis.summary_en: This study analyzed three nationwide cross-sectional serosurveys (PIENTER) from 1995-1996, 2006-2007, and 2016-2017, involving 14,444 participants aged 15-79 years, to assess trends in HBV, HCV, and HIV seroprevalence in the Netherlands. Weighted analyses showed that HBV seroprevalence remained stable (3%-5% past or present infection; < 0.4% active infection), HCV stayed low (< 0.4%), and HIV prevalence was 0.1%. Infections were concentrated among first-generation and non-Western migrants and men who have sex with men, with only 9% of active HBV cases aware of their status. These findings support targeted prevention and screening strategies to achieve WHO elimination goals and underscore the need for continued population-based monitoring.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有有效的 传播 和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和 HIV 仍然是公共卫生挑战,感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例和进一步的 传播。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群中,有许多未发现的感染,因此需要对 血清流行率 随着时间的推移的趋势进行评估。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用了三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的数据,包括 14,444 名 15-79 岁的参与者,以估计 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率、确定决定因素并评估 20 年来的趋势。
elements_zh.methods: 参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的 HBV 和 HCV 以及 HIV 样本进行了血清样本检测。血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染),在第一代移民中最高,只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。HCV 血清流行率 仍然较低(< 0.4%),在非西方移民中最高,而 HIV 患病率 为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中最高。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体而言,荷兰的HBV、HCV和HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认知有限的特定群体中,这表明虽然一般人群患病率稳定,但在这些亚群中存在持续的传播风险。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素,但使用二十年来三项大规模全国性调查的加权数据为评估人口趋势提供了中等水平的证据。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 尽管有有效的 传播 和预防措施,乙型肝炎 (HBV)、丙型肝炎 (HCV) 和 HIV 仍然是公共卫生挑战,感染通常无症状,导致未确诊病例和进一步的 传播。在荷兰,疾病负担集中在特定人群中,有许多未发现的感染,因此需要对 血清流行率 随着时间的推移的趋势进行评估。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究利用了三项全国性横断面血清调查(PIENTER:1995-1996、2006-2007 和 2016-2017)的数据,包括 14,444 名 15-79 岁的参与者,以估计 HBV、HCV 和 HIV 血清流行率、确定决定因素并评估 20 年来的趋势。
analysis_zh.methods: 参与者完成了有关人口统计、行为和社会经济因素的问卷调查,并在 2017 年对所有轮次的 HBV 和 HCV 以及 HIV 样本进行了血清样本检测。血清流行率 估计值根据荷兰人口进行加权,使用加权泊松回归分析趋势,并使用多变量泊松回归评估决定因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 加权 HBV 血清流行率 在整个调查中保持稳定(3%-5% 过去或现在感染;< 0.4% 活动性感染),在第一代移民中最高,只有 9% 的活动性 HBV 病例知道自己的状况。HCV 血清流行率 仍然较低(< 0.4%),在非西方移民中最高,而 HIV 患病率 为 0.1%,在非西方移民和男男性行为者中最高。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 总体而言,荷兰的HBV、HCV和HIV 血清流行率仍然较低,但集中在认知有限的特定群体中,这表明虽然一般人群患病率稳定,但在这些亚群中存在持续的传播风险。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持有针对性的预防、筛查和与护理挂钩的战略,以实现世卫组织 2030 年消除目标,并强调持续进行基于人群的(血清)监测以指导公共卫生政策的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告具体的设计限制、偏差或混杂因素,但使用二十年来三项大规模全国性调查的加权数据为评估人口趋势提供了中等水平的证据。

papers.title: Hepatitis B virus Seroprevalence Among Heterosexual Couples Attending Antenatal Care at Gulu Regional Referral Hospital, Uganda
papers.abstract: Background: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) is a global health concern and the leading cause of chronic liver disease, including liver cirrhosis and hepatocellular carcinoma. The Uganda Ministry of health recommends screening of HBV for all pregnant mothers during antenatal care (ANC). However, limited literature exists regarding couple testing and outcomes, particularly in Northern Uganda. Objective We determined HBV seroprevalence and associated factors among pregnant women and their partner attending ANC clinic of Gulu Regional Referral hospital (GRRH), Gulu, Uganda. Methods Between 1st December 2023 and 28th February 2024, a hospital-based, cross-sectional study was conducted among eligible pregnant women and their male partners attending ANC of GRRH, Gulu, Uganda. Following systematic random sampling, pretested questionnaire was administered by an interviewer. Blood samples were collected for HBV surface antigen (HBsAg) rapid test, which was performed according to manufacturer’s instructions. Qualitative data was analysed using logistic regression in STATA version 15 SE. P<0.05 was considered statistically significant. Results A total of 242 couple pairs were enrolled. Overall, 8.3% (n=40) participants were seropositive for HBsAg; Male partners [M] (10.7%, n=26) and pregnant women [F] (5.8%, n=14). Sero-concordance (M negative [-ve] and F [-ve]; 83.5%, n=202), (M positive [+ve] and F [+ve]; 4.1%, n=10) and sero-discordance (M +ve and F -ve; 8.7%, n=21), (M -ve and F +ve; 3.7%, n=9). Factors associated with positive HBsAg were, being male (adjusted odds ratio [aOR]: 2.45, 95% Confidence Interval [CI], 1.15 - 5.21, p=0.02), daily alcohol consumption (aOR: 4.73, 95% CI: 1.40 -16.04, p=0.01), and no prior vaccination against HBV (aOR: 12.01, 95% CI: 4.07 - 35.65, p<0.001). Conclusion There is a high HBsAg seropositivity rate, particularly among male partners of pregnant women. There is an urgent need to have couples who come for ANC to be screened for HBV and to strengthen and sensitise young people for premarital HBV screening.

papers.title: Impact of Removing the Universal Hepatitis B Birth-Dose Vaccination in the US.
papers.abstract: IMPORTANCE: In December 2025, the Advisory Committee on Immunization Practices (ACIP) voted to replace the universal hepatitis B birth-dose recommendation with shared clinical decision-making for infants born to mothers who screen negative for hepatitis B surface antigen. Although the proposal would not alter recommendations for infants of unscreened mothers, historical data suggest that removing a universal birth-dose vaccine recommendation may reduce vaccination coverage in this group. OBJECTIVE: To estimate the impact of replacing universal hepatitis B virus (HBV) birth-dose vaccination with a targeted recommendation on neonatal and subsequent chronic HBV infections in the US. DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: A compartmental model and simulated a US birth cohort (n = 3 659 289) under the 2 vaccine recommendations: universal birth-dose vaccination and targeted birth-dose vaccination vaccine recommendations, where the birth dose was recommended to infants of screened-positive or unscreened mothers and shared-decision making is recommended for infants of screened-negative mothers. Parameter values were literature derived and uncertainty was incorporated across 5000 iterations. These data were analyzed from September through November 2025. EXPOSURES: Birth-dose vaccine recommendations and birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers. MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Numbers of neonatal and subsequent chronic HBV infections. RESULTS: With the current maternal HBV screening rate of 86%, the universal birth-dose vaccine recommendation resulted in a median of 1292 neonatal infections (95% percentile interval [PI], 670-2228). In comparison, the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation was associated with 628 additional neonatal infections (95% PI, 340-1034) when birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers was 10% (mirroring historic coverage declines under a targeted recommendation) and 69 additional infections (95% PI, -32 to 190) when coverage was 80% (mirroring levels under a universal recommendation.) To offset the excess infections under the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation, more than 100 000 additional pregnant individuals would need to be screened if the birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers was 80%, and more than 400 000 if coverage was 10%. CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: Findings from this study indicate that the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation will likely increase neonatal infections unless maternal screening rises substantially or vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers exceeds current levels. As historic data show such improvements are unlikely, these findings underscore the continued importance of universal screening and vaccination as complementary safeguards.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study was needed to evaluate the potential impact of replacing universal hepatitis B birth-dose vaccination with a targeted recommendation on neonatal and chronic HBV infections in the US, given the ACIP's 2025 decision to change the policy.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A compartmental model simulated a US birth cohort of 3,659,289 infants under two vaccine recommendations: universal birth-dose vaccination and targeted birth-dose vaccination, with parameter values derived from literature and uncertainty incorporated across 5,000 iterations.
analysis.methods: The model compared outcomes under universal versus targeted birth-dose vaccination recommendations, using maternal HBV screening rates and birth-dose vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers as key variables.
analysis.main_results: With an 86% maternal screening rate, universal birth-dose vaccination resulted in a median of 1,292 neonatal infections (95% PI, 670-2,228), while the targeted recommendation was associated with 628 additional neonatal infections (95% PI, 340-1,034) at 10% coverage and 69 additional infections (95% PI, -32 to 190) at 80% coverage among infants of unscreened mothers.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that the targeted birth-dose vaccine recommendation will likely increase neonatal infections unless maternal screening rises substantially or vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers exceeds current levels, highlighting the continued importance of universal screening and vaccination as complementary safeguards.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: These findings inform policy decisions by suggesting that removing universal birth-dose vaccination could lead to increased HBV infections unless accompanied by substantial improvements in maternal screening or vaccination coverage, emphasizing the need for careful consideration of alternative safeguards.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence strength is moderate due to the reliance on a compartmental model with parameter uncertainty, though the large sample size and extensive iterations provide robust estimates; limitations include the assumption that historical coverage trends will continue and the potential for unmodeled real-world factors.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the impact of replacing universal hepatitis B birth-dose vaccination with a targeted recommendation in the US. Using a compartmental model simulating a birth cohort of 3,659,289 infants, the researchers found that the targeted policy would likely increase neonatal HBV infections unless maternal screening rates rise substantially or vaccination coverage among infants of unscreened mothers exceeds current levels. With an 86% maternal screening rate, universal vaccination prevented a median of 1,292 neonatal infections, while the targeted approach could lead to hundreds more infections depending on coverage rates. The study underscores the importance of universal screening and vaccination as complementary safeguards against HBV transmission.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 鉴于 ACIP 于 2025 年决定改变政策,这项研究需要评估以针对美国新生儿和慢性 HBV 感染的针对性建议取代通用乙型肝炎出生剂量 疫苗接种 的潜在影响。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 隔室模型模拟了美国 3,659,289 名婴儿在两个 疫苗 建议下的出生 队列研究:通用出生剂量 疫苗接种 和目标出生剂量 疫苗接种,参数值来自文献,并纳入了 5,000 次迭代的不确定性。
elements_zh.methods: 该模型使用孕产妇 HBV 筛查率和未筛查母亲的婴儿出生剂量 疫苗接种 覆盖率作为关键变量,比较了普遍与目标出生剂量 疫苗接种 建议下的结果。
elements_zh.main_results: 在86%的产前筛查率下,普遍出生剂量疫苗接种导致中位数为1,292例新生儿感染(95%预测区间,670-2,228),而针对性建议在10%覆盖率下与628例额外新生儿感染相关(95%预测区间,340-1,034),在80%覆盖率下与69例额外感染相关(95%预测区间,-32至190),这些感染均发生在未筛查母亲的婴儿中。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,目标出生剂量 疫苗 的建议可能会增加新生儿感染,除非孕产妇筛查大幅增加,或者未筛查母亲的婴儿的 疫苗接种 覆盖率超过目前的水平,这凸显了普遍筛查和 疫苗接种 作为补充保障措施的持续重要性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为政策决策提供了信息,表明取消通用出生剂量 疫苗接种 可能会导致 HBV 感染增加,除非伴随着孕产妇筛查或 疫苗接种 覆盖率的实质性改善,强调需要仔细考虑替代保障措施。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 尽管大样本量和广泛的迭代提供了稳健的估计,但由于依赖于具有参数不确定性的分区模型,证据强度中等;局限性包括历史覆盖率趋势将持续的假设以及未建模的现实世界因素的潜力。

papers.title: Longitudinal Patterns of Chronic Hepatitis B Care and Treatment Adherence in Australia: A National Linked Data Cohort Study.
papers.abstract: Current uptake of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) treatment and care in Australia is well below target levels, leading to an ongoing burden of preventable liver disease and cancer. Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

Understanding individual-level trajectories of care engagement and variation by sociodemographic factors is essential to guide efforts to improve access to and retention in care. This study analysed records of hepatitis B viral load (VL) testing and antiviral treatment provided through Australia's national health insurance system, which were linked to migration, death, and sociodemographic data from various government datasets. Treatment and VL testing by population group were assessed, and uptake was calculated using modelled estimates of the number living with CHB. VL testing frequency and treatment adherence based on scripts dispensed were also assessed. Of the estimated 219,800 people living with CHB in Australia in 2023, 118,334 (53.8%) received either VL testing or treatment during 2014-2023. Estimated uptake of VL testing and treatment uptake were lower among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people and also varied by region of birth. Of the 81,360 who received any VL testing, only 17,352 (21.3%) received it regularly, while 31,715 (39.0%) had evidence of prior monitoring but no VL testing since 2019. The majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy and received supply sufficient for adherence. This study shows that substantial gaps exist in CHB care in Australia, particularly in continued monitoring among those not on treatment. Disparities in uptake are evident by priority population. Re-engaging those lost to follow-up should be prioritised.

analysis.summary_en: This study examines the patterns of chronic hepatitis B (CHB) care and treatment adherence in Australia using national health insurance and government datasets. It highlights that current treatment and care uptake is below target levels, contributing to preventable liver disease and cancer. The analysis reveals disparities in VL testing and treatment among Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander populations and by region of birth. While the majority of those who initiated treatment continued therapy, significant gaps in monitoring persist for those not on treatment. These findings underscore the need for targeted interventions to improve care and retention, particularly for vulnerable groups. The study's reliance on modelled estimates and linked data may limit the precision of its conclusions, but the evidence is strong enough to identify critical areas for public health action.

papers.title: Hepatocellular Carcinoma Risk Between Untreated Immune Tolerant Vs. Treated Immune Active Chronic Hepatitis B Patients.
papers.abstract: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations. We aim to evaluate long-term risks of cirrhosis, HCC, and overall mortality between U-IT vs. T-IA CHB patients among a national cohort of U.S. We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups. A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified (mean age 56.4-57.5 years, 45%-50% non-Hispanic white, 37%-40% African American, 9%-10% Asian, 25%-29% concurrent diabetes, 35%-39% with FIB-4 > 3.25). Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

papers.source_body_en: The risk of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) between chronic hepatitis B (CHB) patients in the untreated immune tolerant (U-IT) vs. treated immune active (T-IA) phases is not clear, and most data are in Asian populations. We aim to evaluate long-term risks of cirrhosis, HCC, and overall mortality between U-IT vs. T-IA CHB patients among a national cohort of U.S. We conducted a propensity score weighted analysis of Veterans with CHB who met criteria for U-IT or T-IA from 1/1/2010 to 12/31/2021 (with follow-up through 12/31/2024). Incidence of cirrhosis, HCC, or death were compared between U-IT and T-IA groups. A total of 591 U-IT and 555 T-IA CHB patients were identified (mean age 56.4-57.5 years, 45%-50% non-Hispanic white, 37%-40% African American, 9%-10% Asian, 25%-29% concurrent diabetes, 35%-39% with FIB-4 > 3.25). Over a median follow up of 6.4 years (IQR 3.0-10.4), incidence of HCC was significantly lower in U-IT patients vs. T-IA patients (0.28 vs. 0.54 per 100 person-years; HR 0.52, 95% CI 0.32-0.83, p = 0.007). However, the risk of cirrhosis or all-cause mortality was similar between both T-IA and U-IT CHB patients. Among a predominantly non-Asian cohort of adults with CHB, we observed that HCC risk was lower in U-IT patients compared to T-IA patients. While this contrasts with some studies in Asian countries, these data do emphasize the importance of prioritizing and ensuring timely therapy for CHB patients in the IA phase. However, routine treatment in IT patients remains controversial and more data are needed to better understand long-term outcomes.

papers.title: Factors Associated With Surface Antigen (HBsAg) Clearance in a Spanish Cohort of Chronic Hepatitis B Patients: Influence on the Long-Term Prognosis.
papers.abstract: The objective is to identify factors that contribute to hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance in patients with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) infection in an unselected, long-term follow-up hepatitis B open cohort in southern Spain. A prospective open cohort study of 453 patients with CHB infection was recruited in the Liver Unit of the Internal Department of two hospitals in Málaga (Spain) between 1991 and 2022 to assess the incidence of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg) clearance during follow-up, identify factors related to it, and determine the influence that clearance had on the long-term prognosis. The duration of follow-up ranged from 0.5 to 36.08 years. A multivariate Cox regression analysis was conducted to identify factors associated with HBsAg clearance. The impact of clearance on long-term prognosis was evaluated using a combined prognostic end point: need for liver transplantation, liver complications, or liver-related mortality. The construction of time-to-event curves was achieved by employing the Kaplan-Meir method, with subsequent comparison of event occurrence between groups conducted via log-rank test. During the subsequent follow-up period, 96/453 patients (21.2%) lost surface antigen (1.96/100 patients per year). Multivariate Cox regression analysis identified as independent factors associated with HBsAg clearance: age at first assessment over 40 years: HR 2.21 (1.38-3.52); a baseline DNA HBV peak below 3.3log10 (< 2000 IU/mL): HR 3.44 (2.01-5.89); loss of hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg) during follow-up: HR 7.23 (3.87-13.50). The incidence of HBsAg clearance was 1.96 cases/100 patient-years. It was more frequent in patients older than 40 years, with baseline DNA-HBV below 3.3 log10 (< 2000 IU/mL), and in chronic HBeAg+ patients who lost HBeAg during follow-up. HBsAg clearance was associated with a better long-term hepatic prognosis.
