elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 在乙型肝炎相关的慢加急性肝衰竭 (HBV-ACLF) 中,乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 复制和 宿主 免疫之间的相互作用仍不清楚。本研究旨在探讨血清 HBV RNA 与细胞因子驱动的过度炎症之间的动态拮抗作用,并评估其综合预后价值。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这项前瞻性 队列研究 研究(2021 年 3 月至 2022 年 12 月)中,纳入了 133 名 HBV-ACLF 患者。
elements_zh.methods: 测量 HBV RNA 和 Th1/Th2 细胞因子(IFN-γ、TNF-α、IL-4、IL-6、IL-10)的血清水平。Logistic 回归分析用于确定 12 周预后的独立预测因素,并构建和内部验证预后模型。
elements_zh.main_results: 与幸存者相比,非幸存者 (40.6%,54/133) 的 HBV RNA 水平显着降低(2.97 ± 1.22 vs. 4.05 ± 1.30 log 10 拷贝/mL,p < 0.001),但 IFN-γ 水平高出 1.2 倍(p < 0.001)。HBV RNA 和 IFN-γ 之间观察到强烈的负相关(r = -0.326,p < 0.001)。多变量逻辑回归确定 HBV RNA(AUC = 0.730,最佳截止值 = 3.98 log 10 拷贝/mL)和 IFN-γ(AUC = 0.821,最佳截止值 = 496.23 pg/mL)作为 12 周 死亡率 的独立预测因子。包含这些因素的列线图表现出卓越的预测性能 (AUC = 0.917),优于 MELD 评分,并达到与 COSSH-ACLF II 评分相当的准确性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: HBV RNA 和 Th1 细胞因子形成 HBV-ACLF 的动态预后轴。HBV RNA 的下降表明病毒已得到控制,但矛盾的是,它预示着与器官衰竭相关的细胞因子驱动的高炎症状态。这种病毒与免疫的相互作用提供了一种新颖的分层工具来指导早期免疫调节治疗,挑战了传统上仅关注病毒载量的做法。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为 HBV-ACLF 提供了一个新的预后轴,可以指导早期免疫调节治疗,有可能改善患者分层和超越传统病毒载量监测的 治疗 决策。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究是作为单中心前瞻性 队列研究 进行的,样本量有限(n=133),这可能会影响普遍性。由于前瞻性设计,证据强度中等,但需要在更大的多中心 队列研究 中进行验证。

papers.title: High Burden of Occult Hepatitis B Infection in HIV-Infected Patients in Southern Vietnam: Insights from Serological and Molecular Analysis
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major concern among people living with HIV (PLWH), particularly in high-endemic settings such as Vietnam. The study evaluated the serological and molecular characteristics of HBV among PLWH receiving antiretroviral therapy (ART) in southern Vietnam. A cross-sectional study was conducted among 316 HIV-infected patients receiving ART. Serological markers (HBsAg, anti-HBs IgG, and anti-HBc IgG) and HBV DNA were assessed using highly sensitive assays, and the Pre-S1/Pre-S2/S regions were sequenced for genotype and mutation analysis. Associations were evaluated using appropriate statistical methods. HBV DNA was detected in 32.6% of the patients, whereas HBsAg was present in only 16.1%. The most common serological profile was susceptibility (36.4%), followed by occult HBV infection (OBI) (17.4%), including 6.6% with completely seronegative OBI, and chronic HBV (CHB) (15.8%). Males and older individuals showed a significantly higher risk of CHB (adjusted odds ratio [aOR] = 2.58 and aOR = 1.87, respectively). Genotype B predominated (78.4%) overall, but genotype C was significantly more frequent in OBI than in CHB patients (31.5% vs. Moreover, the burden of surface S gene escape mutations was significantly higher in the OBI group (p = 0.023). The LASSO model showed a moderate discriminatory ability for predicting OBI status (Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic [ROC] Curve [AUC] = 0.76). Lamivudine-associated resistance (rtM204I/V) was the most common RT mutation detected in the overlapping RT/S region. HIV-infected individuals in southern Vietnam face a burden of both CHB and OBI, including a high proportion of seronegative OBI. The presence of seronegative OBI further supports the risk of underdiagnosis when relying only on standard serological markers, and reflects the need for integrated strategies combining highly sensitive serological assays with molecular diagnostics to improve HBV detection among high-risk populations.

The most common serological profile was susceptibility (36.4%), followed by OBI (17.4%, including 6.6% seronegative OBI) and chronic HBV (15.8%). Males and older individuals had a higher risk of chronic HBV. Genotype B predominated, but genotype C was more frequent in OBI patients. The study underscores the risk of underdiagnosis with standard serological markers and advocates for integrated molecular and serological diagnostics to improve HBV detection in high-risk populations.

papers.title: Seroepidemiological Characteristics and Influencing Factors of Hepatitis B Virus Infection Among Pregnant Women in Nanning City, China (2024–2025): A Cross-Sectional Study
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection remains a major public health concern among pregnant women, with regional disparities in epidemic characteristics that hinder precise prevention of mother-to-child transmission (MTCT). This study aimed to characterize the seroepidemiological profiles of HBV infection and identify its associated influencing factors among pregnant women in Nanning City, providing evidence-based insights for optimizing targeted interventions to block HBV MTCT. A stratified cluster random sampling strategy was adopted to recruit pregnant women receiving routine antenatal care at designated medical institutions across Nanning between October 2024 and May 2025. Standardized face-to-face questionnaires were administered to collect demographic, behavioral, and disease-related data. Venous blood samples were collected for quantitative detection of five serological HBV markers via chemiluminescence immunoassay. The Kruskal–Wallis test was used to compare the geometric mean concentration (GMC) of hepatitis B surface antibody (HBsAb), while the chi-square test was applied to analyze intergroup differences in the seropositivity rates of the five HBV markers. Multivariate unconditional logistic regression models were constructed to explore factors independently associated with seropositivity of hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg), HBsAb, and hepatitis B core antibody (HBcAb). A total of 1,935 eligible pregnant women were enrolled. The overall seropositivity rates of HBsAg, HBsAb, hepatitis B e-antigen (HBeAg), hepatitis e-antibody (HBeAb), and HBcAb were 6.98%, 59.48%, 1.50%, 15.50%, and 33.02%, respectively. Seropositivity of HBsAg, HBsAb, HBeAb, and HBcAb exhibited an age-dependent ascending trend, with the lowest rates observed in the 14–19 age group and peak rates in the 40–49 age group. Rural residents presented significantly higher HBsAg and HBeAb seropositivity but lower HBsAb seropositivity compared with urban counterparts. Participants with unknown or no prior HBV vaccination history showed markedly higher seropositivity of HBsAg, HBeAg, HBeAb, and HBcAb, alongside reduced HBsAb positivity, relative to those vaccinated within the past 5 years or ≥5 years prior (all P < 0.001). Furthermore, individuals vaccinated ≥5 years ago demonstrated higher HBV marker seropositivity and lower HBsAb positivity than those vaccinated within 5 years (all P < 0.001). Multivariate logistic regression revealed that advanced maternal age, rural residency, comorbid chronic underlying diseases, and close contact with HBV carriers/patients were independent risk factors for HBsAg seropositivity, whereas prior HBV vaccination exerted a protective effect. Advanced age, higher educational attainment, and HBV vaccination history independently predicted higher odds of HBsAb positivity; rural residency, chronic comorbidities, and non-medical occupational status were risk factors for insufficient HBsAb seroconversion. For HBcAb seropositivity, advanced age, chronic underlying diseases, and exposure to HBV-infected individuals were independent risk factors, while higher education and vaccination history served as protective factors. HBV prevalence among pregnant women in Nanning exceeds the national average, accompanied by prominent urban–rural disparities. Advanced maternal age and the presence of chronic comorbidities increase HBV infection vulnerability, while vaccination coverage among childbearing-age women remains suboptimal with progressive attenuation of protective antibody titers over time. We recommend targeted booster HBV vaccination for childbearing-age women with insufficient HBsAb levels to curb incident HBV infections and mitigate the risk of vertical transmission.

analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted among pregnant women receiving routine antenatal care at designated medical institutions in Nanning City between October 2024 and May 2025. A total of 1,935 eligible participants were enrolled using a stratified cluster random sampling strategy.
analysis.methods: Standardized face-to-face questionnaires collected demographic, behavioral, and disease-related data. Multivariate unconditional logistic regression models identified factors independently associated with seropositivity of HBsAg, HBsAb, and HBcAb.
analysis.main_results: The overall seropositivity rates were 6.98% for HBsAg, 59.48% for HBsAb, 1.50% for HBeAg, 15.50% for HBeAb, and 33.02% for HBcAb. analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study identified advanced maternal age, rural residency, chronic comorbidities, and close contact with HBV carriers as independent risk factors for HBsAg seropositivity, while prior HBV vaccination was protective. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the need for targeted HBV vaccination strategies, including booster doses for women with insufficient HBsAb levels, to reduce incident infections and mitigate vertical transmission risk in Nanning City.

analysis.summary_en: This cross-sectional study in Nanning City, China, characterized the seroepidemiology of HBV infection among 1,935 pregnant women between October 2024 and May 2025. It reported overall HBsAg seropositivity of 6.98% and identified age-dependent trends, with higher infection rates in older women and rural residents. Multivariate analysis revealed advanced maternal age, rural residency, chronic comorbidities, and exposure to HBV carriers as independent risk factors for HBsAg positivity, while prior vaccination conferred protection. The study highlighted suboptimal vaccination coverage and waning antibody titers over time, recommending targeted booster vaccination for childbearing-age women to reduce incident infections and vertical transmission risk. Limitations include the cross-sectional design, which precludes causal inference, and reliance on serological markers without confirmatory virological or longitudinal data, warranting moderate confidence in the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染对孕妇构成持续的公共卫生挑战,流行模式的地区差异使预防母婴 传播 (MTCT) 的工作变得更加复杂。该研究解决了有关该人群乙型肝炎病毒感染的血清流行病学特征和影响因素的知识差距,为有针对性的干预措施提供信息。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2024年10月至2025年5月在南宁市定点医疗机构接受常规产前保健的孕妇进行横断面研究。采用分层整群随机抽样策略,共纳入1,935名符合条件的受试者。
elements_zh.methods: 标准化面对面调查问卷收集人口、行为和疾病相关数据。使用化学发光免疫测定法分析静脉血样本中的五种 HBV 血清学标志物(HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAg、HBeAb、HBcAb)。多变量无条件逻辑回归模型确定了与 HBsAg、HBsAb 和 HBcAb 血清阳性独立相关的因素。
elements_zh.main_results: 总体血清阳性率为 HBsAg 6.98%、HBsAb 59.48%、HBeAg 1.50%、HBeAb 15.50% 和 HBcAb 33.02%。HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAb 和 HBcAb 的血清阳性率随着年龄的增长而增加,在 40-49 岁年龄组达到峰值。农村居民的HBsAg和HBeAb血清阳性率高于城市居民,但HBsAb血清阳性率低于城市居民。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定高龄产妇、农村居民、慢性合并症以及与 HBV 携带者的密切接触是 HBsAg 血清阳性的独立危险因素,而既往 HBV 疫苗接种 具有保护作用。它强调了育龄妇女中 疫苗接种 覆盖率不理想,并且抗体滴度随着时间的推移而下降。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,南宁市需要有针对性的 HBV 传播 策略,包括对 HBsAb 水平不足的女性进行加强剂量,以减少感染事件并减轻垂直 传播 风险。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项横断面研究,因果推断是有限的,尽管进行了多变量调整,残留的混杂因素可能仍然存在。由于依赖血清学标记而没有确凿的病毒学或纵向数据,因此证据强度中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 感染对孕妇构成持续的公共卫生挑战,流行模式的地区差异使预防母婴 传播 (MTCT) 的工作变得更加复杂。该研究解决了有关该人群乙型肝炎病毒感染的血清流行病学特征和影响因素的知识差距,为有针对性的干预措施提供信息。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 对2024年10月至2025年5月在南宁市定点医疗机构接受常规产前保健的孕妇进行横断面研究。采用分层整群随机抽样策略,共纳入1,935名符合条件的受试者。
analysis_zh.methods: 标准化面对面调查问卷收集人口、行为和疾病相关数据。使用化学发光免疫测定法分析静脉血样本中的五种 HBV 血清学标志物(HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAg、HBeAb、HBcAb)。多变量无条件逻辑回归模型确定了与 HBsAg、HBsAb 和 HBcAb 血清阳性独立相关的因素。
analysis_zh.main_results: 总体血清阳性率为 HBsAg 6.98%、HBsAb 59.48%、HBeAg 1.50%、HBeAb 15.50% 和 HBcAb 33.02%。HBsAg、HBsAb、HBeAb 和 HBcAb 的血清阳性率随着年龄的增长而增加,在 40-49 岁年龄组达到峰值。农村居民的HBsAg和HBeAb血清阳性率高于城市居民,但HBsAb血清阳性率低于城市居民。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究确定高龄产妇、农村居民、慢性合并症以及与 HBV 携带者的密切接触是 HBsAg 血清阳性的独立危险因素,而既往 HBV 疫苗接种 具有保护作用。它强调了育龄妇女中 疫苗接种 覆盖率不理想,并且抗体滴度随着时间的推移而下降。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调,南宁市需要有针对性的 HBV 传播 策略,包括对 HBsAb 水平不足的女性进行加强剂量,以减少感染事件并减轻垂直 传播 风险。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 作为一项横断面研究,因果推断是有限的,尽管进行了多变量调整,残留的混杂因素可能仍然存在。由于依赖血清学标记而没有确凿的病毒学或纵向数据,因此证据强度中等。

papers.title: Novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors regulate dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of Hepatitis B virus X protein (HBx)
papers.abstract: The hepatitis B virus (HBV) X protein (HBx) is a key player in viral transcription, replication, and HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis. Several novel HBx-interacting host cellular factors: DDX1, DDX3, MOV10 RNA helicases, INI1/hSNF5 chromatin-remodeling factor, Rad18 DNA repair enzyme, and CPSF6 cleavage factor were identified. DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. In contrast, INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli. Importantly, DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 restricted HBV replication, whereas CPSF6 facilitated HBV replication. Furthermore, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. Altogether, HBx-interacting host factors determine dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.

analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted in a laboratory setting using human HBV infection models. It involved the identification of host factors interacting with HBx through biochemical and cellular assays.
analysis.methods: The researchers used biochemical and cellular assays to identify HBx-interacting host factors, including colocalization studies in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates and nuclear speckles, interchromatin granule clusters (IGCs), and/or PML-nuclear bodies. They also assessed the impact of these factors on HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription.
analysis.main_results: DDX1, DDX3, and MOV10 colocalized with HBx in cytoplasmic foci or aggregates. INI1/hSNF5 and CPSF6 relocalized with HBx in nuclear speckles, IGCs, and/or PML-nuclear bodies. Rad18 sequestered HBx in the nucleoli.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted that HBx-interacting host factors determine the dynamic nuclear and cytoplasmic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and HBx-mediated transcription. analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide insights into the molecular mechanisms of HBV replication and pathogenesis, which could inform the development of targeted therapies and improve understanding of HBV-associated hepatocarcinogenesis.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on abstract-only evidence and does not provide detailed statistical analyses or experimental controls. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of comprehensive data on the functional impact of these factors in vivo.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the interaction of HBV X protein (HBx) with host cellular factors and their role in regulating HBx localization and viral replication. The research identifies several novel factors, including DDX1, DDX3, MOV10, INI1/hSNF5, CPSF6, and Rad18, which interact with HBx in different subcellular compartments. DDX3, MOV10, and INI1/hSNF5 were found to restrict HBV replication, while CPSF6 facilitated it. Additionally, DDX1 enhanced HBx-mediated NF-κB transcription, whereas MOV10 and Rad18 inhibited it. The authors conclude that these HBx-interacting factors determine the dynamic localization of HBx and regulate HBV replication and transcription. The study provides important insights into the molecular mechanisms of HBV pathogenesis, which may have implications for the development of targeted therapies. However, the evidence is based solely on abstract information and lacks detailed experimental validation.

elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用生化和细胞测定来识别 HBx 相互作用的 宿主 因子,包括细胞质灶或聚集体和核斑点、染色质间颗粒簇 (IGC) 和/或 PML 核体的共定位研究。他们还评估了这些因素对 HBV 复制和 HBx 介导的转录的影响。

elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现提供了对 HBV 复制和 发病机制 的分子机制的见解,这可以为靶向治疗的开发提供信息并提高对 HBV 相关肝癌发生的理解。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅基于抽象证据,不提供详细的统计分析或实验对照。由于缺乏有关这些因素体内功能影响的全面数据,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Risk factors for low-level viremia in tenofovir disoproxil fumarate-treated chronic hepatitis B patients with advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated cirrhosis
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND Patients diagnosed with chronic hepatitis B (CHB) complicated by advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated cirrhosis face a significant risk of disease progression. Despite first-line nucleos(t)ide analog therapy, some patients continues to exhibit low-level viremia (LLV). Furthermore, LLV is closely associated with accelerated liver fibrosis progression and a higher likelihood of hepatocellular carcinoma. Clinical studies on accurate prognostic indicators for LLV in this patient group are still comparatively rare. AIM To identify the high-risk factors linked to the occurrence of LLV among CHB patients with advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated cirrhosis. METHODS This retrospective study enrolled 141 CHB patients with advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated cirrhosis who received tenofovir disoproxil fumarate (TDF). Patients were allocated into two groups according to their virological response at week 48 after treatment initiation: LLV, defined as hepatitis B virus (HBV) DNA levels of 20-2000 IU/mL, and complete virological response (CVR), defined as HBV DNA levels below 20 IU/mL. Univariate and multivariate logistic regression analysis were carried out to determine risk factors for LLV development. RESULTS A total of 141 patients were included in this study, among whom 17.0% (24/141) developed LLV. Significant differences were identified between the LLV and CVR groups regarding baseline HBV DNA, HBV RNA, hepatitis B e antigen positivity, HBV DNA ≥ 5.0 Log10 IU/mL, 6.0 Log10 IU/mL, 7.0 Log10 IU/mL, HBV RNA ≥ 5.0 Log10 copies/mL, and baseline alpha-fetoprotein. Multivariate logistic regression confirmed that that HBV DNA ≥ 7.0 Log10 IU/mL (OR = 18.824, 95%CI: 1.608-220.404, P = 0.019) at baseline was associated with the occurrence of LLV. CONCLUSION In TDF-treated CHB with advanced hepatic fibrosis/compensated liver cirrhosis, HBV DNA ≥ 7.0 Log10 IU/mL is a high-risk factor associated with LLV.

papers.title: Nivolumab Induced Reactivation of Hepatitis B in a Patient with Metastatic Gastric Adenocarcinoma—A Case Report
papers.abstract: Background and Clinical Significance: The most common cause of liver toxicity with the use of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) is autoimmune hepatitis. As most patients with prior viral infections such as hepatitis B and hepatitis C were excluded in trials for the use of ICIs, the safety of ICIs in these patients with active or prior treated hepatitis is unknown. With expanded use of these medications in many malignancies, it is important to understand the risk of viral reactivation with these medications. There are only few case series and reports documenting hepatitis B reactivations with the use of ICIs. Case Presentation: We present a middle-aged woman with a history of treated hepatitis B who presented with metastatic gastric cancer. She was treated with two cycles of 5-FU, oxaliplatin and nivolumab followed by maintenance nivolumab. After 14 months of nivolumab, she developed marked transaminitis and was found to have reactivation of hepatitis B. As autoimmune hepatitis was the initial suspicion, the patient was initiated on prednisone 1 mg/kg with no improvement in transaminases. Due to the significant elevation of HBV DNA, she was diagnosed with hepatitis B reactivation. She was initiated on entecavir with normalization of transaminases and improvement in HBV DNA levels. She was successfully rechallenged with nivolumab with no evidence of recurrent transaminitis or worsening HBV DNA levels. Conclusions: There are case series of HBV reactivation with the use of ICIs. We believe that any patients with known history of HBV should get baseline viral titers prior to initiation of ICIs with serial monitoring of DNA levels. Prospective studies to evaluate risk of reactivation may need to be performed for us to get a better understanding of risks of viral reactivation and potential effects it may have on safety and efficacy of ICIs.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to understand the risk of hepatitis B reactivation in patients with a history of treated hepatitis B who are treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs), as this risk was not well established due to exclusion of such patients from initial trials.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This was a case report of a middle-aged woman with a history of treated hepatitis B who developed metastatic gastric cancer and was treated with nivolumab.
analysis.methods: The patient was treated with two cycles of 5-FU, oxaliplatin and nivolumab followed by maintenance nivolumab, and was monitored for liver toxicity and hepatitis B reactivation.
analysis.main_results: After 14 months of nivolumab treatment, the patient developed marked transaminitis and was found to have reactivation of hepatitis B, confirmed by significant elevation of HBV DNA.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted this case as evidence of hepatitis B reactivation induced by nivolumab, highlighting that this is a known but not widely documented risk with ICIs.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that patients with a known history of hepatitis B should have baseline viral titers prior to initiation of ICIs with serial monitoring of DNA levels to prevent reactivation.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The evidence is limited to a single case report, which provides low confidence in the generalizability of the findings, though the detailed clinical course strengthens the internal validity.

analysis.summary_en: This case report describes a middle-aged woman with a history of treated hepatitis B who developed metastatic gastric cancer and was treated with nivolumab. After 14 months of treatment, she experienced marked transaminitis and was diagnosed with hepatitis B reactivation, confirmed by elevated HBV DNA levels. Despite initial suspicion of autoimmune hepatitis, the patient responded to entecavir with normalization of transaminases and HBV DNA levels, and was successfully rechallenged with nivolumab without recurrence. The authors highlight the importance of baseline viral titers and serial monitoring for patients with hepatitis B history receiving ICIs, though the evidence is limited to a single case.

elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单个 病例报告,尽管详细的临床过程增强了内部有效性,但对研究结果的普遍性的信心较低。

She was treated with two cycles of 5-FU,oxaliplatin and nivolumab followed by maintenance nivolumab.使用纳武利尤单抗 14 个月后,她出现明显的转氨酶升高,并被发现乙型肝炎重新激活。由于最初怀疑是自身免疫性肝炎,患者开始服用泼尼松 1 mg/kg,但转氨酶没有改善。Due to the significant elevation of HBV DNA,she was diagnosed with hepatitis B reactivation. She was initiated on entecavir with normalization of transaminases and improvement in HBV DNA levels. She was successfully rechallenged with nivolumab with no evidence of recurrent transaminitis or worsening HBV DNA levels. Conclusions: There are case series of HBV reactivation with the use of ICIs.我们认为,任何已知有 HBV 病史的患者都应在开始 ICI 之前通过 DNA 水平连续监测获得基线病毒滴度。我们可能需要进行评估病毒再激活风险的前瞻性研究,以更好地了解病毒再激活的风险及其对 ICI 安全性和有效性的潜在影响。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在了解有乙型肝炎治疗史并接受免疫检查点抑制剂(ICIs)治疗的患者乙型肝炎再激活的风险,因为由于将此类患者排除在初始试验之外,这种风险尚未得到充分确定。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 这是一位中年女性的 病例报告,她有乙型肝炎治疗史,后来患上转移性胃癌,并接受了纳武单抗治疗。
analysis_zh.methods: 该患者接受了两个周期的 5-FU、奥沙利铂和纳武单抗治疗,随后接受纳武单抗维持治疗,并监测肝毒性和乙型肝炎再激活。
analysis_zh.main_results: 使用纳武单抗 治疗 14 个月后,患者出现明显的转氨炎,并发现乙型肝炎重新激活,HBV DNA 显着升高证实了这一点。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将此病例解释为纳武利尤单抗诱导乙型肝炎再激活的证据,强调这是 ICI 的已知但尚未广泛记录的风险。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,已知有乙型肝炎病史的患者在开始 ICI 之前应检测基线病毒滴度,并连续监测 DNA 水平,以防止病毒再激活。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 证据仅限于单个 病例报告,尽管详细的临床过程增强了内部有效性,但对研究结果的普遍性的信心较低。

papers.title: Hepatitis B knowledge, attitudes, prevention practices, and associated factors among graduating health sciences students at Bahir Dar University, Ethiopia
papers.abstract: Hepatitis B virus infection is a major public health concern with a high contagious rate via blood and body fluids. It is a vaccine-preventable disease. Graduate-level students of health sciences are future healthcare professionals who play a crucial role in the prevention and management of hepatitis B virus. However, they are also at increased risk of exposure to the virus. The study was aimed to assess knowledge, attitude and prevention practices towards HBV infection and associated factors among graduate students at the College of Medicine and Health Sciences, Bahir Dar University. A cross-sectional study was conducted at the College of Medicine and Health Sciences, Bahir Dar University, from 15 January to 14 March 2024, using a pre-tested, structured, self-administered questionnaire. A total of 149 eligible participants who met the inclusion criteria were enrolled in the study. Data were entered and analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences version 25. Frequencies, percentages and binary logistic regression were employed to summarize and interpret the data. A multivariable logistic regression analysis was conducted to assess associations, with statistical significance defined as a p-value ≤ 0.05 and 95% confidence intervals. Only variables with a p-value ≤ 0.2 in the univariate analysis were included in the multivariate analysis to account for potential confounding. A total of 86 (57.7%) participants demonstrated good knowledge about hepatitis B, while nearly half (48.3%) exhibited a favorable attitude, and 76 participants (51%) reported good practices. Those studying medicine (AOR: 8.56; 95% CI: 2.42–30.29), nursing (AOR: 3.88; 95% CI: 1.07–14.00), pharmacy (AOR: 6.26; 95% CI: 1.33–29.55), and medical laboratory science (AOR: 4.12; 95% CI: 1.01–16.80) were more likely to have good knowledge. Furthermore, students who had received prior training on hepatitis B virus infection were also more likely to have good knowledge (AOR: 5.37; 95% CI: 1.79–16.23). However, pharmacy students were found to have significantly lower levels of good practice (AOR: 0.07; 95% CI: 0.01–0.68). Health science students showed greater knowledge about hepatitis B virus infection and its prevention strategies compared to their attitudes and practices. Knowledge levels were significantly associated with the students’ field of study and prior training on hepatitis B virus, while practice levels also showed a significant association with the field of study.

The study aimed to assess knowledge, attitude and prevention practices towards HBV infection and associated factors among graduate students at the College of Medicine and Health Sciences, Bahir Dar University.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A cross-sectional study was conducted at the College of Medicine and Health Sciences, Bahir Dar University, from 15 January to 14 March 2024, using a pre-tested, structured, self-administered questionnaire. A total of 149 eligible participants who met the inclusion criteria were enrolled in the study.
analysis.methods: Data were entered and analyzed using Statistical Package for the Social Sciences version 25. Frequencies, percentages and binary logistic regression were employed to summarize and interpret the data, with a multivariable logistic regression analysis conducted to assess associations, where statistical significance was defined as a p-value ≤ 0.05 and 95% confidence intervals.
analysis.main_results: A total of 86 (57.7%) participants demonstrated good knowledge about hepatitis B, while nearly half (48.3%) exhibited a favorable attitude, and 76 participants (51%) reported good practices. The study highlights the gap between knowledge and actual preventive practices, emphasizing the need for targeted educational interventions and hepatitis B training in health science curricula to improve prevention efforts among future healthcare professionals.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 需要进行这项研究是因为 乙型肝炎病毒 感染是一个主要的公共卫生问题,通过血液和体液具有很高的传染率,并且它是一种 疫苗 可预防的疾病。该研究旨在评估巴赫达尔大学医学与健康科学学院研究生对乙型肝炎病毒感染的知识、态度和预防实践以及相关因素。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 2024 年 1 月 15 日至 3 月 14 日,巴赫达尔大学医学与健康科学学院使用预先测试的结构化自填问卷进行了一项横断面研究。共有 149 名符合纳入标准的参与者参加了该研究。
elements_zh.methods: 使用社会科学统计包第 25 版输入和分析数据。采用频率、百分比和二元逻辑回归来总结和解释数据,并使用多变量逻辑回归分析来评估关联性,其中统计显着性定义为 p 值 ≤ 0.05 和 95% 置信区间。
elements_zh.main_results: 共有 86 名(57.7%)参与者表现出对乙型肝炎的良好了解,近一半(48.3%)表现出良好态度,76 名参与者(51%)报告了良好做法。与他们的态度和实践相比,健康科学专业的学生对 乙型肝炎病毒 感染及其预防策略表现出更多的了解。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者解释说,知识水平与学生的学习领域和之前的 乙型肝炎病毒 培训显着相关,而实践水平也与学习领域显着相关。该研究强调,尽管健康科学专业的学生拥有良好的知识,但他们对乙型肝炎预防的态度和做法并不理想。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为有针对性的教育干预措施提供信息,以改善健康科学学生的乙型肝炎预防实践,特别是在药学等实践明显较低的领域。该研究强调了将乙型肝炎培训纳入健康科学课程以加强未来医疗保健专业人员的预防工作的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究受到横断面设计的限制,无法建立因果关系,而且样本量相对较小(只有 149 名参与者)。证据强度中等,因为该研究提供了有关知识、态度和实践的宝贵见解,但可能无法完全推广到其他环境或人群。

A total of 86 (57.7%) participants demonstrated good knowledge about hepatitis B, while nearly half (48.3%) exhibited a favorable attitude, and 76 participants (51%) reported good practices. Furthermore, students who had received prior training on hepatitis B virus infection were also more likely to have good knowledge (AOR: 5.37; 95% CI: 1.79–16.23). However, pharmacy students were found to have significantly lower levels of good practice (AOR: 0.07; 95% CI: 0.01–0.68). Health science students showed greater knowledge about hepatitis B virus infection and its prevention strategies compared to their attitudes and practices. papers.title: Preoperative gut microbiota combined with machine learning for predicting post-hepatectomy liver failure in HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma: a pilot study
papers.abstract: Objective This study investigated the association between preoperative gut microbiota (GM) profiles and post-hepatectomy liver failure (PHLF) in patients with newly diagnosed HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HBV-HCC), aiming to explore non-invasive, modifiable GM biomarkers for perioperative risk stratification. Methods A total of 233 fecal samples underwent 16S rRNA sequencing and were stratified into three distinct sets: a training set ( n = 179), an internal validation set ( n = 32), and an independent external validation set ( n = 22). Preoperative GM features were compared between patients with and without PHLF to identify diagnostic biomarkers and construct machine learning-driven risk models (XGBoost, Random Forest [RF], and Gradient Boosting Machine [GBM]). Results Significant β-diversity differences (Weighted UniFrac) were observed between the groups, identifying 11 differential genera; PHLF patients exhibited a characteristic enrichment of Faecalibacterium, and Blautia, alongside a profound depletion of Bacteroides. Functional inferences revealed distinct metabolic remodeling in the PHLF group, characterized by the upregulation of amino acid biosynthesis (specifically lysine and arginine) and nucleoside catabolism, coupled with a prominent downregulation of the hepatic-interactive urea cycle, central carbon metabolism (glycolysis and tricarboxylic acid [TCA] cycle), and short-chain fatty acid [SCFA] (butyrate) metabolism. In the independent external validation set, the XGBoost, RF, and GBM models achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) of 78.12%, 71.88%, and 63.54%, respectively. Importantly, the models showed potent exclusionary performance, with specificities of 81.25% for XGBoost and RF versus 72.22% for GBM, while all three maintained a stable negative predictive value (NPV) of 81.25% and exceptionally stable negative F1-scores (F1- negative).Decision curve analysis (DCA) confirmed notable clinical net benefit of all models. Conclusion We are among the first to characterize distinct GM signatures in PHLF patients with cross-geographic reproducibility. GM demonstrates strong potential as a non-invasive tool for preoperative risk stratification targeting the primary endpoint of PHLF. Characterized by high specificity and potent exclusionary capacity, this signature establishes a clinically robust framework for accurate low-risk patient identification and triage, thereby optimizing perioperative management.

papers.title_zh: 术前肠道微生物群结合机器学习预测 HBV 相关肝细胞癌肝切除术后肝功能衰竭:一项试点研究
papers.source_body_en: Objective This study investigated the association between preoperative gut microbiota (GM) profiles and post-hepatectomy liver failure (PHLF) in patients with newly diagnosed HBV-related hepatocellular carcinoma (HBV-HCC), aiming to explore non-invasive, modifiable GM biomarkers for perioperative risk stratification. Methods A total of 233 fecal samples underwent 16S rRNA sequencing and were stratified into three distinct sets: a training set ( n = 179), an internal validation set ( n = 32), and an independent external validation set ( n = 22). Preoperative GM features were compared between patients with and without PHLF to identify diagnostic biomarkers and construct machine learning-driven risk models (XGBoost, Random Forest [RF], and Gradient Boosting Machine [GBM]). Results Significant β-diversity differences (Weighted UniFrac) were observed between the groups, identifying 11 differential genera; PHLF patients exhibited a characteristic enrichment of Faecalibacterium, and Blautia, alongside a profound depletion of Bacteroides. Functional inferences revealed distinct metabolic remodeling in the PHLF group, characterized by the upregulation of amino acid biosynthesis (specifically lysine and arginine) and nucleoside catabolism, coupled with a prominent downregulation of the hepatic-interactive urea cycle, central carbon metabolism (glycolysis and tricarboxylic acid [TCA] cycle), and short-chain fatty acid [SCFA] (butyrate) metabolism. In the independent external validation set, the XGBoost, RF, and GBM models achieved areas under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUCs) of 78.12%, 71.88%, and 63.54%, respectively. Importantly, the models showed potent exclusionary performance, with specificities of 81.25% for XGBoost and RF versus 72.22% for GBM, while all three maintained a stable negative predictive value (NPV) of 81.25% and exceptionally stable negative F1-scores (F1- negative).Decision curve analysis (DCA) confirmed notable clinical net benefit of all models. Conclusion We are among the first to characterize distinct GM signatures in PHLF patients with cross-geographic reproducibility. GM demonstrates strong potential as a non-invasive tool for preoperative risk stratification targeting the primary endpoint of PHLF. Characterized by high specificity and potent exclusionary capacity, this signature establishes a clinically robust framework for accurate low-risk patient identification and triage, thereby optimizing perioperative management.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的 本研究调查了新诊断的 HBV 相关肝细胞癌 (HBV-HCC) 患者术前肠道微生物群 (GM) 特征与肝切除术后肝衰竭 (PHLF) 之间的关联,旨在探索用于围手术期风险分层的非侵入性、可修改的 GM 生物标志物。方法 对总共 233 份粪便样本进行 16S rRNA 测序,并分为三个不同的组:训练集 (n = 179)、内部验证集 (n = 32) 和独立的外部验证集 (n = 22)。对患有和不患有 PHLF 的患者的术前 GM 特征进行比较,以确定诊断生物标志物并构建机器学习驱动的风险模型(XGBoost、随机森林 [RF] 和梯度提升机 [GBM])。结果 各组之间观察到显着的 β 多样性差异(加权 UniFrac),鉴定出 11 个差异属;PHLF 患者表现出粪杆菌和布劳氏菌的特征性富集,同时拟杆菌明显减少。功能推论揭示了 PHLF 组中明显的代谢重塑,其特征是氨基酸生物合成(特别是赖氨酸和精氨酸)和核苷分解代谢的上调,同时肝脏相互作用的尿素循环、中心碳代谢(糖酵解和三羧酸 [TCA] 循环)和短链脂肪酸 [SCFA](丁酸)代谢显着下调。在独立的外部验证集中,XGBoost、RF 和 GBM 模型的受试者工作特征曲线下面积 (AUC) 分别为 78.12%、71.88% 和 63.54%。重要的是,这些模型显示出强大的排除性能,XGBoost 和 RF 的特异性为 81.25%,GBM 的特异性为 72.22%,而所有三个模型都保持了 81.25% 的稳定阴性预测值 (NPV) 和异常稳定的阴性 F1 分数(F1- 阴性)。决策曲线分析 (DCA) 证实了所有模型的显着临床净效益。结论 我们是最早描述 PHLF 患者不同 GM 特征的人之一,具有跨地理可重复性。GM 展示了作为针对 PHLF 主要终点的术前风险分层的非侵入性工具的巨大潜力。该特征具有高特异性和强大的排除能力,为准确的低风险患者识别和分诊建立了临床上稳健的框架,从而优化围手术期管理。

papers.title: The Effect of Hepatitis B and Alcohol Coexistence on the Development of Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Cirrhotic Patients
papers.abstract: Introduction: This study aimed to retrospectively compare the incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), overall survival (OS), and HCC-fr ee survival among patients with cirr hosis of differen t etiologies: alcohol-related, hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related, and combined HBV-alcohol-related.Additionally, the relationship between HBV viral load and HCC-free survival was evaluated in HBV-positive patients.Methods: This retrospective single-center cohort study included 648 patients with cirrhosis followed for more than 6 months between July 2007 and April 2014.The patients were categorized into three etiological groups: alcohol-related cirrhosis (n=310), HBV-related cirrhosis (n=294), and HBV-alcohol-related cirrhosis (n=44).Clinical characteristics, HCC incidence, overall survival, and HCC-free survival were compared across these groups.Results: During the follow-up period, HCC developed in 138 (21.3%) of the 648 patients.The prevalence of HCC differed significantly among the groups: 5.5% in the alcohol group, 34.7% in the HBV group, and 43.2% in the combined HBV-alcohol group (p<0.001).The 5-year cumulative HCC risk was 7% for the alcohol group, 40% for the HBV group, and 49% for the HBV-alcohol group.Despite these striking differences in HCC incidence, overall survival did not differ significantly among the etiological groups (p=0.367).Furthermore, in HBV-positive patients, baselin e HBV DNA viral load (<10 6 vs. ≥10 6 copies/mL) did not show a statistically significant difference in HCC-free survival (p=0.408).Conclusion: HBV infection, particularly when combined with heavy alcohol use, significantly and synergistically increases the risk of HCC in patients with liver cirrhosis.The exceptionally high cumulative HCC incidence in the combined HBV-alcohol group, with 40% of patients developing HCC within the first year, underscores the critical need for close surveillance in this high-risk subgroup.Despite the differing HCC rates, overall survival remain s similar across the groups, reflecting the complex and multifactorial determin ants of cirrhosis-related mortality .

papers.title_original: The Effect of Hepatitis B and Alcohol Coexistence on the Development of Hepatocellular Carcinoma in Cirrhotic Patients

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to retrospectively compare the incidence of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), overall survival (OS), and HCC-free survival among patients with cirrhosis of different etiologies: alcohol-related, hepatitis B virus (HBV)-related, and combined HBV-alcohol-related. Additionally, the relationship between HBV viral load and HCC-free survival was evaluated in HBV-positive patients.
analysis.study_design_and_population: This retrospective single-center cohort study included 648 patients with cirrhosis followed for more than 6 months between July 2007 and April 2014. The patients were categorized into three etiological groups: alcohol-related cirrhosis (n=310), HBV-related cirrhosis (n=294), and HBV-alcohol-related cirrhosis (n=44).
analysis.methods: Clinical characteristics, HCC incidence, overall survival, and HCC-free survival were compared across the three etiological groups. The relationship between HBV DNA viral load (<10^6 vs. ≥10^6 copies/mL) and HCC-free survival was evaluated in HBV-positive patients.
analysis.main_results: During the follow-up period, HCC developed in 138 (21.3%) of the 648 patients. The prevalence of HCC differed significantly among the groups: 5.5% in the alcohol group, 34.7% in the HBV group, and 43.2% in the combined HBV-alcohol group (p<0.001). The 5-year cumulative HCC risk was 7% for the alcohol group, 40% for the HBV group, and 49% for the HBV-alcohol group. Overall survival did not differ significantly among the etiological groups (p=0.367).
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: HBV infection, particularly when combined with heavy alcohol use, significantly and synergistically increases the risk of HCC in patients with liver cirrhosis. The exceptionally high cumulative HCC incidence in the combined HBV-alcohol group, with 40% of patients developing HCC within the first year, underscores the critical need for close surveillance in this high-risk subgroup.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings highlight the importance of considering HBV-alcohol coexistence as a major risk factor for HCC development in cirrhotic patients, emphasizing the need for enhanced surveillance strategies in this high-risk population.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its retrospective single-center design and relatively small sample size for the combined HBV-alcohol group (n=44). Despite these limitations, the evidence strength is moderate due to the large overall sample size and statistically significant findings.

analysis.summary_en: This retrospective cohort study investigated the impact of hepatitis B virus (HBV) and alcohol coexistence on hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) development in 648 cirrhotic patients. Patients were categorized into alcohol-related (n=310), HBV-related (n=294), and combined HBV-alcohol-related (n=44) cirrhosis groups. Results showed significantly higher HCC incidence in the HBV group (34.7%) and combined group (43.2%) compared to the alcohol group (5.5%), with 5-year cumulative risks of 40% and 49%, respectively. Despite these differences, overall survival was similar across groups. HBV viral load did not significantly affect HCC-free survival. The study demonstrates that HBV infection, especially when combined with alcohol, synergistically increases HCC risk, necessitating close surveillance in this high-risk subgroup.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在回顾性比较不同病因的肝硬化患者中肝细胞癌 (HCC) 的 发病率、总生存期 (OS) 和无 HCC 生存期:酒精相关、发病率 (HBV) 相关以及 HBV 与酒精联合相关。此外,在 HBV 阳性患者中评估了 HBV 病毒载量与无 HCC 生存率之间的关系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 这项回顾性单中心 队列研究 研究纳入了 2007 年 7 月至 2014 年 4 月期间随访超过 6 个月的 648 名肝硬化患者。患者被分为三个病因组:酒精相关性肝硬化 (n=310)、HBV 相关性肝硬化 (n=294) 和 HBV 酒精相关性肝硬化 (n=44)。
elements_zh.methods: 比较三个病因组的临床特征、HCC 发病率、总生存期和无 HCC 生存期。在 HBV 阳性患者中评估了 HBV DNA 病毒载量(<10^6 与 ≥10^6 拷贝/mL)与无 HCC 生存率之间的关系。
elements_zh.main_results: 在随访期间,648 名患者中有 138 名(21.3%)发展为 HCC。HCC 的 患病率 在各组之间存在显着差异:酒精组为 5.5%,HBV 组为 34.7%,HBV 与酒精联合组为 43.2%(p<0.001)。酒精组的 5 年累积 HCC 风险为 7%,HBV 组为 40%,HBV 酒精组为 49%。不同病因组之间的总生存率没有显着差异(p=0.367)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 乙型肝炎病毒感染,特别是与大量饮酒相结合,会显着且协同地增加肝硬化患者患肝癌的风险。HBV-酒精联合治疗组中累计 HCC 发病率 异常高,其中 40% 的患者在第一年内发展为 HCC,这突显了这一高风险亚组迫切需要密切使用 发病率。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了将 HBV-酒精共存视为肝硬化患者发生 HCC 的主要危险因素的重要性,并强调在这一高危人群中需要加强 监测 策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究因其回顾性单中心设计和 HBV-酒精联合组的样本量相对较小(n=44)而受到限制。尽管存在这些限制,但由于总体样本量大且具有统计显着性,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Mathematical and Dynamical Analysis of Hepatitis B Model with Hybrid Operator Piecewise Classical and Fractional Derivative Insight of Different Stages of Vaccinations
papers.abstract: In order to observe the dynamics and impacts of vaccination at different phases, we suggested an epidemic model in this paper that includes classical and Atangana-Baleanu piecewise operators for the hybrid operator’s memory effects. The created model’s properties, which take into account linear growth and Lipschitz requirements relating the rate of effects within its many sub-compartments according to the equilibrium points, include positivity, unique solution, existence, and boundedness in the feasible domain. The reproductive number \(R_0\) is derived for the biological feasibility of the model with sensitivity analysis with different parameters impacting the model for the piecewise fractional operator. Global stability employs Lyapunov function theory to gain insight into first derivative results. The chaotic behavior of the system was also determined through simulation, which shows the solution is bound to a steady state point and lies in a feasible region.For numerical solutions, classical and piecewise fractional hybrid operators at various fractional order values are solved using the Newton polynomial interpolation method.This research advances our knowledge of the dynamics of hepatitis B and offers a solid framework for assessing the effectiveness of interventions for disease control planning and decision-making.
papers.journal: International Journal of Analysis and Applications

The created model’s properties, which take into account linear growth and Lipschitz requirements relating the rate of effects within its many sub-compartments according to the equilibrium points, include positivity, unique solution, existence, and boundedness in the feasible domain. The reproductive number \(R_0\) is derived for the biological feasibility of the model with sensitivity analysis with different parameters impacting the model for the piecewise fractional operator. Global stability employs Lyapunov function theory to gain insight into first derivative results. The chaotic behavior of the system was also determined through simulation, which shows the solution is bound to a steady state point and lies in a feasible region.For numerical solutions, classical and piecewise fractional hybrid operators at various fractional order values are solved using the Newton polynomial interpolation method.This research advances our knowledge of the dynamics of hepatitis B and offers a solid framework for assessing the effectiveness of interventions for disease control planning and decision-making.
source_records.journal: International Journal of Analysis and Applications

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study addresses the need to understand hepatitis B virus (HBV) dynamics and the impact of vaccination across different phases using a mathematical model. It aims to explore how hybrid operators incorporating classical and fractional derivatives can capture memory effects relevant to HBV transmission and control.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The authors propose a mathematical epidemic model for HBV that integrates classical and Atangana-Baleanu piecewise operators to account for memory effects in transmission dynamics. The model is analyzed for properties such as positivity, existence, uniqueness, and boundedness within a feasible domain.
analysis.methods: The reproductive number \(R_0\) is derived to assess biological feasibility, and sensitivity analysis is performed to evaluate the impact of different parameters on the model under the piecewise fractional operator. Global stability is examined using Lyapunov function theory, and numerical solutions are obtained via the Newton polynomial interpolation method for classical and piecewise fractional hybrid operators at varying fractional orders.
analysis.main_results: The chaotic behavior of the system is determined through simulation, demonstrating that solutions remain bound to a steady state within a feasible region. The model advances understanding of HBV dynamics and provides a framework for evaluating intervention effectiveness in disease control planning.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interprets the findings as evidence that hybrid operators with memory effects can effectively model HBV transmission dynamics, offering new insights into the stability and control of HBV spread. The novelty lies in applying piecewise fractional operators to HBV modeling and demonstrating system stability through Lyapunov theory.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings suggest that incorporating memory effects into HBV models may improve the assessment of vaccination strategies and inform public health decision-making for disease control and intervention planning.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The supplied evidence does not report empirical validation, real-world data application, or clinical outcomes, limiting the strength of the conclusions. The abstract-only evidence and reliance on theoretical modeling reduce generalizability and practical applicability.

analysis.summary_en: This study proposes a mathematical model for hepatitis B virus (HBV) dynamics that integrates classical and Atangana-Baleanu piecewise fractional operators to incorporate memory effects. The model is analyzed for biological feasibility, including positivity, existence, uniqueness, and boundedness, and the reproductive number \(R_0\) is derived with sensitivity analysis. Global stability is assessed using Lyapunov function theory, and numerical simulations demonstrate chaotic behavior bound to a steady state. The Newton polynomial interpolation method is used to solve classical and piecewise fractional hybrid operators at varying orders. The authors interpret the results as advancing HBV dynamics understanding and providing a framework for evaluating vaccination strategies. However, the abstract-only evidence lacks empirical validation or clinical data, limiting the strength and generalizability of the findings.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了使用数学模型了解 乙型肝炎病毒 (HBV) 动态以及 疫苗接种 在不同阶段的影响的需要。它旨在探索结合经典和分数导数的混合算子如何捕获与 HBV 传播 和控制相关的记忆效应。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 作者提出了一种 HBV 数学流行病模型,该模型集成了经典和 Atangana-Baleanu 分段算子,以解释 传播 动力学中的记忆效应。分析模型的属性,例如可行域内的正性、存在性、唯一性和有界性。
elements_zh.methods: 推导出再生数\(R_0\)来评估生物学可行性,并进行敏感性分析来评估分段分数算子下不同参数对模型的影响。使用李亚普诺夫函数理论检查全局稳定性,并通过牛顿多项式插值法获得不同分数阶的经典和分段分数混合算子的数值解。
elements_zh.main_results: 系统的混沌行为是通过仿真确定的,证明解决方案在可行区域内保持稳定状态。该模型增进了对 HBV 动态的理解,并为评估疾病控制计划中的干预效果提供了框架。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将这些发现解释为证据,表明具有记忆效应的混合算子可以有效地模拟 HBV 传播 动态,为 HBV 传播的稳定性和控制提供新的见解。新颖之处在于将分段分数算子应用于 HBV 建模并通过 Lyapunov 理论证明系统稳定性。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果表明,将记忆效应纳入 HBV 模型可能会改善 疫苗接种 策略的评估,并为疾病控制和干预计划的公共卫生决策提供信息。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告经验验证、现实世界数据应用或临床结果,限制了结论的强度。仅抽象的证据和对理论模型的依赖降低了普遍性和实际适用性。

papers.title: HBcAg-Induced IL-17F drives liver fibrosis in occult HBV infection
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT While occult hepatitis B virus infection is a known risk factor for progressive liver diseases, the mechanistic basis for this association is poorly understood. To investigate this, we conducted a comparative study involving 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to assess clinical parameters of liver fibrosis, including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement. Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from these donors identified IL-17F as significantly upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistically, we found that IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4 + T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of key fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. Collectively, our study unveils a novel pathway wherein HBcAg induces CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease. IMPORTANCE This study reveals, for the first time, a novel mechanism by which OBI drives liver fibrosis, demonstrating that HBcAg stimulates CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn activates macrophages and hepatic stellate cells, thereby promoting liver inflammation and fibrosis. This discovery not only elucidates a key molecular pathway underlying OBI-related liver disease progression, but also provides an important theoretical foundation for developing IL-17F-targeted diagnostic approaches and anti-fibrotic therapies.

papers.source_body_en: ABSTRACT While occult hepatitis B virus infection is a known risk factor for progressive liver diseases, the mechanistic basis for this association is poorly understood. To investigate this, we conducted a comparative study involving 40 OBI blood donors and 100 healthy blood donors to assess clinical parameters of liver fibrosis, including serum biomarkers, the FIB-4 index, and liver stiffness measurement. Transcriptome sequencing of peripheral blood mononuclear cells from these donors identified IL-17F as significantly upregulated in the OBI group. Mechanistically, we found that IL-17F was chiefly secreted by CD4 + T cells upon HBcAg stimulation and functionally promoted the expression of key fibrosis-related cytokines and markers. Collectively, our study unveils a novel pathway wherein HBcAg induces CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn accelerates liver fibrogenesis, providing a mechanistic basis for OBI-associated liver disease. IMPORTANCE This study reveals, for the first time, a novel mechanism by which OBI drives liver fibrosis, demonstrating that HBcAg stimulates CD4 + T cells to secrete IL-17F, which in turn activates macrophages and hepatic stellate cells, thereby promoting liver inflammation and fibrosis. This discovery not only elucidates a key molecular pathway underlying OBI-related liver disease progression, but also provides an important theoretical foundation for developing IL-17F-targeted diagnostic approaches and anti-fibrotic therapies.

papers.title: Comparison of Factors Associated With 30-Day and 90-Day Readmission Among a Global Cohort of Patients Hospitalised With Cirrhosis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: It remains unclear whether different factors influence 30- and 90-day readmission rates. We identified predictors of 90-day mortality in a global cohort of hospitalised patients with cirrhosis. METHODS: Variables associated with 30- and 90-day post-discharge readmission, liver transplantation (LT), and mortality were compared in prospectively enrolled, non-electively hospitalised adult patients with cirrhosis. RESULTS: We enrolled 4208 patients from 125 centres across 37 countries. Alcohol-related liver disease was the most common aetiology of cirrhosis (40%), followed by hepatitis B virus infection (21%); 47% were readmitted, 8% received liver transplantation (LT), and 23% died within 90 days post-discharge. In multivariable analysis, country income was significantly associated with both 30- and 90-day readmission rates, the receipt of LT, and mortality within 30 and 90 days post-discharge (all p-values < 0.001). Independent predictors of higher rates of 30- and 90-day readmissions, respectively, were disease severity (p < 0.001, p = 0.003), prior ascites (p = 0.025, p = 0.016), prior hospitalisation (p < 0.001), hyponatremia (p < 0.001, p = 0.008), and in-hospital vasopressor use (p = 0.002, p = 0.011). Prior variceal bleeding independently predicted higher 90-day readmission rates, whereas age, disease severity, mechanical ventilation, and in-hospital vasopressor use (all, p < 0.001) increased odds of 30- and 90-day post-discharge death. Additionally, admission (p = 0.011) and nosocomial (p = 0.022) infections increased the odds of 90-day post-discharge death. CONCLUSION: In a global cohort of hospitalised patients with cirrhosis, patients in high-income countries exhibited the highest rates of 30- and 90-day readmission, alongside lower mortality rates and a higher incidence of LT. Variables that predict 30-day readmission also predicted 90-day readmission. Understanding these disparities is essential for achieving health equity.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究探讨了不同的临床或人口统计因素是否对肝硬化住院患者 30 天和 90 天的再入院产生不同的影响,并指出相同的预测因素是否适用于这些时间范围的不确定性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 一项前瞻性、多中心、全球 队列研究 研究纳入了 37 个国家 125 个中心的非选择性住院成年肝硬化患者。

analysis_en.methods: Variables associated with 30- and 90-day post-discharge readmission, liver transplantation, and mortality were compared using multivariable analyses to identify independent predictors.

papers.title_zh: 全球肝硬化住院患者 队列研究 中与 30 天和 90 天再入院相关的因素比较。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND AND AIMS: It remains unclear whether different factors influence 30- and 90-day readmission rates. We identified predictors of 90-day mortality in a global cohort of hospitalised patients with cirrhosis. METHODS: Variables associated with 30- and 90-day post-discharge readmission, liver transplantation (LT), and mortality were compared in prospectively enrolled, non-electively hospitalised adult patients with cirrhosis. RESULTS: We enrolled 4208 patients from 125 centres across 37 countries. Alcohol-related liver disease was the most common aetiology of cirrhosis (40%), followed by hepatitis B virus infection (21%); 47% were readmitted, 8% received liver transplantation (LT), and 23% died within 90 days post-discharge. In multivariable analysis, country income was significantly associated with both 30- and 90-day readmission rates, the receipt of LT, and mortality within 30 and 90 days post-discharge (all p-values < 0.001). Independent predictors of higher rates of 30- and 90-day readmissions, respectively, were disease severity (p < 0.001, p = 0.003), prior ascites (p = 0.025, p = 0.016), prior hospitalisation (p < 0.001), hyponatremia (p < 0.001, p = 0.008), and in-hospital vasopressor use (p = 0.002, p = 0.011). Prior variceal bleeding independently predicted higher 90-day readmission rates, whereas age, disease severity, mechanical ventilation, and in-hospital vasopressor use (all, p < 0.001) increased odds of 30- and 90-day post-discharge death. Additionally, admission (p = 0.011) and nosocomial (p = 0.022) infections increased the odds of 90-day post-discharge death. CONCLUSION: In a global cohort of hospitalised patients with cirrhosis, patients in high-income countries exhibited the highest rates of 30- and 90-day readmission, alongside lower mortality rates and a higher incidence of LT. Variables that predict 30-day readmission also predicted 90-day readmission. Understanding these disparities is essential for achieving health equity.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景和目的:尚不清楚不同因素是否影响 30 天和 90 天的再入院率。我们在肝硬化住院患者的全球 队列研究 中确定了 90 天 死亡率 的预测因子。方法:在前瞻性入组、非选择性住院的成年肝硬化患者中,比较与出院后 30 天和 90 天再入院、肝移植 (LT) 和 死亡率 相关的变量。结果:我们招募了来自 37 个国家 125 个中心的 4208 名患者。酒精相关性肝病是肝硬化最常见的病因(40%),其次是 乙型肝炎病毒 感染(21%);47% 的患者再次入院,8% 的患者接受肝移植 (LT),23% 的患者在出院后 90 天内死亡。在多变量分析中,国家收入与 30 天和 90 天的再入院率、LT 的接受情况以及出院后 30 和 90 天内的 死亡率 显着相关(所有 p 值 < 0.001)。30 天和 90 天再入院率较高的独立预测因素分别是疾病严重程度 (p < 0.001,p = 0.003)、既往腹水 (p = 0.025,p = 0.016)、既往住院情况 (p < 0.001)、低钠血症 (p < 0.001,p = 0.008) 和住院情况血管加压药的使用(p = 0.002,p = 0.011)。既往静脉曲张出血独立预测较高的 90 天再入院率,而年龄、疾病严重程度、机械通气和院内血管加压药的使用(全部,p < 0.001)增加出院后 30 天和 90 天的死亡几率。此外,入院感染 (p = 0.011) 和院内感染 (p = 0.022) 会增加出院后 90 天的死亡几率。结论:在全球肝硬化住院患者 队列研究 中,高收入国家患者的 30 天和 90 天再入院率最高,同时 死亡率 率较低,LT 发病率 较高。预测 30 天再入院的变量也预测 90 天再入院。了解这些差异对于实现健康公平至关重要。

papers.title: Patient-Derived Liver Cancer Organoids Reflect Tumor Biology and Their Growth Phenotype Correlates with Clinical Outcomes
papers.abstract: Liver cancer remains a major global health burden with high mortality and limited treatment response prediction tools. Patient-derived cancer organoids have emerged as promising preclinical models that recapitulate tumor heterogeneity; however, the biological significance of morphological diversity within established organoids remains poorly characterized in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). In this exploratory study, we investigated whether distinct organoid growth phenotypes reflect underlying tumor biology and correlate with clinical outcomes. We established liver cancer organoids from resected tumor tissues of 27 patients and analyzed their clinical, histological, and genomic characteristics. Organoids were classified morphologically into cystic and solid types. Whole exome sequencing (WES) was conducted on six matched tumor-organoid pairs to assess genomic fidelity. Associations between organoid establishment, growth characteristics, and clinical parameters were statistically evaluated. Progression-free survival (PFS) was analyzed using the Kaplan-Meier method and univariate Cox proportional hazards regression. Organoids were successfully established in 13 of 27 cases (48.1%). Solid-type organoids were significantly associated with shorter PFS compared to cystic types (HR = 13.91; p = 0.0039, log-rank test). Organoid establishment was more frequent in older patients (>70 years), those with HBV infection, and tumors with positive beta-catenin expression. WES analysis demonstrated high concordance in somatic mutation profiles and variant allele frequency distributions between tissues and corresponding organoids. In univariate Cox regression, organoid growth pattern (solid vs. cystic) showed a significant association with PFS within this exploratory cohort (p = 0.0207). Patient-derived liver cancer organoids preserved the genomic and histopathological features of the original tumors. Notably, solid morphology was associated with shorter PFS, suggesting that organoid growth phenotype may serve as a supplementary indicator of tumor biological behavior in HCC. Given the modest cohort size and the absence of multivariate analysis, these preliminary findings should be interpreted with caution and warrant further large-scale validation.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 肝癌仍然是全球主要的健康负担,死亡率 较高且 治疗 反应预测工具有限。源自患者的癌症类器官已成为有前景的临床前模型,可概括肿瘤异质性;然而,在肝细胞癌(HCC)中,已建立的类器官形态多样性的生物学意义仍然知之甚少。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们从 27 名患者的切除肿瘤组织中建立了肝癌类器官,并分析了它们的临床、组织学和基因组特征。类器官在形态上分为囊状和实性类型。类器官的建立在老年患者(>70 岁)、HBV 感染患者以及 β-catenin 表达阳性的肿瘤中更为频繁。
elements_zh.methods: 对六对匹配的肿瘤类器官进行全外显子组测序 (WES),以评估基因组保真度。对类器官建立、生长特征和临床参数之间的关联进行了统计评估。使用 Kaplan-Meier 方法和单变量 Cox 比例风险回归分析无进展生存期 (PFS)。
elements_zh.main_results: 27 例中有 13 例(48.1%)成功建立了类器官。与囊性类型相比,固体型类器官与较短的 PFS 显着相关(HR = 13.91;p = 0.0039,对数秩检验)。WES 分析表明,组织和相应类器官之间的体细胞 突变 谱和变异等位基因频率分布具有高度一致性。

papers.title_zh: 患者来源的肝癌类器官反映肿瘤生物学及其生长表型与临床结果相关
papers.source_body_en: Liver cancer remains a major global health burden with high mortality and limited treatment response prediction tools. Patient-derived cancer organoids have emerged as promising preclinical models that recapitulate tumor heterogeneity; however, the biological significance of morphological diversity within established organoids remains poorly characterized in hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC). In this exploratory study, we investigated whether distinct organoid growth phenotypes reflect underlying tumor biology and correlate with clinical outcomes. We established liver cancer organoids from resected tumor tissues of 27 patients and analyzed their clinical, histological, and genomic characteristics. Organoids were classified morphologically into cystic and solid types. Whole exome sequencing (WES) was conducted on six matched tumor-organoid pairs to assess genomic fidelity. Associations between organoid establishment, growth characteristics, and clinical parameters were statistically evaluated. Progression-free survival (PFS) was analyzed using the Kaplan-Meier method and univariate Cox proportional hazards regression. Organoids were successfully established in 13 of 27 cases (48.1%). Solid-type organoids were significantly associated with shorter PFS compared to cystic types (HR = 13.91; p = 0.0039, log-rank test). Organoid establishment was more frequent in older patients (>70 years), those with HBV infection, and tumors with positive beta-catenin expression. WES analysis demonstrated high concordance in somatic mutation profiles and variant allele frequency distributions between tissues and corresponding organoids. In univariate Cox regression, organoid growth pattern (solid vs. cystic) showed a significant association with PFS within this exploratory cohort (p = 0.0207). Patient-derived liver cancer organoids preserved the genomic and histopathological features of the original tumors. Notably, solid morphology was associated with shorter PFS, suggesting that organoid growth phenotype may serve as a supplementary indicator of tumor biological behavior in HCC. Given the modest cohort size and the absence of multivariate analysis, these preliminary findings should be interpreted with caution and warrant further large-scale validation.
papers.abstract_zh: 肝癌仍然是全球主要的健康负担,死亡率 较高且 治疗 反应预测工具有限。源自患者的癌症类器官已成为有前景的临床前模型,可概括肿瘤异质性;然而,在肝细胞癌(HCC)中,已建立的类器官形态多样性的生物学意义仍然知之甚少。在这项探索性研究中,我们研究了不同的类器官生长表型是否反映了潜在的肿瘤生物学并与临床结果相关。我们从 27 名患者的切除肿瘤组织中建立了肝癌类器官,并分析了它们的临床、组织学和基因组特征。类器官在形态上分为囊状和实性类型。对六对匹配的肿瘤类器官进行全外显子组测序 (WES),以评估基因组保真度。对类器官建立、生长特征和临床参数之间的关联进行了统计评估。使用 Kaplan-Meier 方法和单变量 Cox 比例风险回归分析无进展生存期 (PFS)。27 例中有 13 例(48.1%)成功建立了类器官。与囊性类型相比,固体型类器官与较短的 PFS 显着相关(HR = 13.91;p = 0.0039,对数秩检验)。类器官的建立在老年患者(>70 岁)、HBV 感染患者以及 β-catenin 表达阳性的肿瘤中更为频繁。WES 分析表明,组织和相应类器官之间的体细胞 突变 谱和变异等位基因频率分布具有高度一致性。在单变量 Cox 回归中,类器官生长模式(实性与囊性)显示出与该探索性 队列研究 中的 PFS 显着相关(p = 0.0207)。患者来源的肝癌类器官保留了原始肿瘤的基因组和组织病理学特征。值得注意的是,实体形态与较短的 PFS 相关,表明类器官生长表型可以作为 HCC 肿瘤生物学行为的补充指标。鉴于 队列研究 规模不大且缺乏多变量分析,这些初步结果应谨慎解释,并需要进一步大规模验证。

Melissa Relief & Recovery Hurricane Beryl Relief & Recovery Emancipendence 2026 Search for:Search Button Medical Officer Urges Precaution Against Hepatitis B By: Serena Grant, August 1, 2026 Listen Education Share Photo: Serena Grant Medical Officer of Health for Westmoreland, Dr. Marcia Graham. The Full Story Residents of Westmoreland are being encouraged to take steps to protect themselves against hepatitis B by getting vaccinated and practising safe sex. Medical Officer of Health for Westmoreland, Dr. Marcia Graham, made the call against the backdrop of World Hepatitis Day, which was observed on July 28. Speaking during the recent monthly meeting of the Westmoreland Municipal Corporation, Dr. Graham said the observance provided an opportunity to raise awareness about a disease that often receives less attention than HIV despite being more infectious. She noted that hepatitis B can survive outside the body for up to a week, making it highly transmissible. She noted that while sexual contact remains the most common means of transmission, many people only discover they are infected after donating blood. “Our blood supply chain is safe... a lot of times that’s how we alert persons that they have hepatitis B because when they donate blood and we test it, it comes back positive,” she pointed out. Hepatitis B is a viral infection that attacks the liver and can lead to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis and liver cancer if left untreated. The virus is spread through contact with infected blood and other body fluids and can be prevented through vaccination, safe health practices and responsible sexual behaviour. Dr. Graham said Jamaica continues to strengthen protection against the disease through newborn vaccination and immunisation for adults at high risk. Listen Education Share Photo: Serena Grant Medical Officer of Health for Westmoreland, Dr. Marcia Graham. The Full Story Residents of Westmoreland are being encouraged to take steps to protect themselves against hepatitis B by getting vaccinated and practising safe sex. Medical Officer of Health for Westmoreland, Dr. Marcia Graham, made the call against the backdrop of World Hepatitis Day, which was observed on July 28. Speaking during the recent monthly meeting of the Westmoreland Municipal Corporation, Dr. Graham said the observance provided an opportunity to raise awareness about a disease that often receives less attention than HIV despite being more infectious. She noted that hepatitis B can survive outside the body for up to a week, making it highly transmissible. She noted that while sexual contact remains the most common means of transmission, many people only discover they are infected after donating blood. “Our blood supply chain is safe... a lot of times that’s how we alert persons that they have hepatitis B because when they donate blood and we test it, it comes back positive,” she pointed out. Hepatitis B is a viral infection that attacks the liver and can lead to chronic liver disease, cirrhosis and liver cancer if left untreated. The virus is spread through contact with infected blood and other body fluids and can be prevented through vaccination, safe health practices and responsible sexual behaviour. Dr. Graham said Jamaica continues to strengthen protection against the disease through newborn vaccination and immunisation for adults at high risk. Meanwhile, she reported an increase in the number of persons admitted with lower respiratory tract infection and encouraged mask-wearing in hospitals and health centres, especially when visiting vulnerable patients. She also reminded residents that proper cough etiquette remains an important infection-prevention measure. Last Updated: August 1, 2026 Post navigation Previous Article Next Article ×

news.content_title: Evaluation of the safety and efficacy of SOF/VEL treatment and pre-treatment of TAF in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus/hepatitis C virus coinfection
news.content: Home Article Highlight | 6-Aug-2026 Evaluation of the safety and efficacy of SOF/VEL treatment and pre-treatment of TAF in patients with chronic hepatitis B virus/hepatitis C virus coinfection Xia & He Publishing Inc. Facebook X LinkedIn WeChat Bluesky Message WhatsApp Email image: SOF/VEL effectively achieves a sustained virologic response and improves liver function, with an acceptable safety profile in chronic HBV/HCV coinfected patients, including those with compensated cirrhosis, who achieved modest improvement in non-invasive fibrosis indices. Pre-administration of TAF may mitigates the risk of HBV reactivation in this population. view more Credit: Xiaoyuan Xu, Yanyan Yu Background and Aims Hepatitis B virus (HBV) infection and hepatitis C virus (HCV) infection are among the leading causes of chronic liver diseases worldwide. Through the same transmission routes, HBV/HCV coinfection is widespread and aggravates liver damage. In this study, we aimed to assess the safety and efficacy of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (SOF/VEL) and the pre-treatment of tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) on HBV reactivation in HBV/HCV coinfected patients. Methods A multicenter, prospective, single-arm, open-label 12-week trial, followed by a 12/48-week observational clinical trial, was conducted. Ninety-six adults with chronic HBV/HCV coinfection were enrolled from May 2021 to December 2024 in thirteen centers in China. Seventy-seven non-cirrhotic patients were included in Group 1 and nineteen compensated cirrhotic patients in Group 2. All subjects were enrolled to receive SOF/VEL once daily for 12 weeks. Non-cirrhotic subjects received TAF once daily for 28 weeks, and compensated cirrhotic subjects received TAF once daily for 64 weeks simultaneously. Statistical significance was set at P < 0.05. Results At the end of SOF/VEL treatment, the overall sustained virologic response was 97.9%, of which 100% was achieved in Group 2. HCV RNA, HBV DNA, and HBV RNA levels were substantially decreased in all patients. Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) (61.5 vs. 21.9, P < 0.001) and aspartate aminotransferase (AST) (50.8 vs. 25.7, P < 0.001) levels decreased, and albumin (ALB) (42.4 vs. 45.1, P < 0.001) level increased compared to pre-treatment in Group 1 at 12 weeks post-treatment. ALT (64.1 vs. 25.2, P < 0.001), AST (65.7 vs. 29.7, P < 0.001), alkaline phosphatase (ALP) (111.6 vs. 88.2, P < 0.05), and alpha-fetoprotein (AFP) (17.9 vs. 4.7, P < 0.05) levels decreased, and ALB (41.3 vs. 42.5, P = 0.051) and platelet count (PLT) (114.0 vs. 127.2, P = 0.052) levels showed a trend toward increase compared to pre-treatment in Group 2 at 48 weeks post-treatment. Liver stiffness measurement (LSM) (22.6 vs. 12.7, P < 0.01), aspartate aminotransferase to platelet ratio index (APRI) (1.6 vs. 0.6, P < 0.001), and fibrosis-4 index (FIB-4) (4.7 vs. 2.6, P < 0.05) significantly decreased after treatment in Group 2. Two patients in Group 1 with genotype 3 showed HBV reactivation and HCV relapse, respectively. No drug-related adverse events were observed in the study. Conclusions SOF/VEL effectively achieves a sustained virologic response and improves liver function, with an acceptable safety profile in chronic HBV/HCV coinfected patients, including those with compensated cirrhosis, who achieved modest improvement in non-invasive fibrosis indices. Pre-administration of TAF may mitigates the risk of HBV reactivation in this population. Each issue includes articles by leading authorities on topics in hepatology that are germane to the most current challenges in the field. Special features include reports on the latest advances in drug development and technology that are relevant to liver diseases. Regular features of JCTH also include editorials, correspondences and invited commentaries on rapidly progressing areas in hepatology. Two patients in Group 1 with genotype 3 showed HBV reactivation and HCV relapse, respectively. No drug-related adverse events were observed in the study. Conclusions SOF/VEL effectively achieves a sustained virologic response and improves liver function, with an acceptable safety profile in chronic HBV/HCV coinfected patients, including those with compensated cirrhosis, who achieved modest improvement in non-invasive fibrosis indices. Pre-administration of TAF may mitigates the risk of HBV reactivation in this population. analysis.time: Published on 6-Aug-2026. The study was conducted from May 2021 to December 2024, with a 12-week treatment phase followed by a 12/48-week observational period.
analysis.location_and_population: China, with participants enrolled from thirteen centers. The study included 96 adults with chronic HBV/HCV coinfection: 77 non-cirrhotic patients (Group 1) and 19 compensated cirrhotic patients (Group 2).
analysis.event: A multicenter, prospective, single-arm, open-label trial evaluating the safety and efficacy of sofosbuvir/velpatasvir (SOF/VEL) with pre-treatment of tenofovir alafenamide fumarate (TAF) in chronic HBV/HCV coinfected patients. The study is confirmed and published in the Journal of Clinical and Translational Hepatology.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: Overall sustained virologic response was 97.9% (100% in Group 2). HCV RNA, HBV DNA, and HBV RNA levels decreased significantly in all patients. Liver function markers improved, and non-invasive fibrosis indices showed modest improvement in Group 2. Two patients in Group 1 experienced HBV reactivation and HCV relapse, respectively. No drug-related adverse events were reported.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The study concluded that SOF/VEL is effective with an acceptable safety profile, and pre-administration of TAF may mitigate HBV reactivation risk.
